title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Restaurationsmanager

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant.
 Your responsibilities will include:
•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service
•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks
•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service
•    Welcoming guests and assisting wherever needed
•    Monitoring service quality and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction
•    Handling guest enquiries and any complaints professionally
•    Coordinating communication and cooperation between the kitchen and front-of-house teams
•    Opening and/or closing the restaurant, including cash reconciliation
•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service
•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:
•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours
Working hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?

title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English

Please note:
You must be an EU/EEA citizen. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply.

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

Work tasks: Automotive and Furniture Upholstery Sewer
(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.

provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

Selleks tuleb igapäevaselt kliendiga koos või tema jaoks teha erinevaid tegevusi: - iseseisvalt elamiseks vajalike oskuste õpetamine; - tööalane nõustamine; - vajadusel arsti külastamine; - juhendamine kodu korrashoiul ja toitumisel; - suhtlemine kliendi lähedastega; - dokumentide haldamine; - vaba aja sisustamise motiveerimine või juhendamine; - võrgustiku- ja meeskonnatöö korraldamine. Kliendiga tehtud töö tuleb dokumenteerida ning see võtab umbes pool tööajast. Töö nõuab tahtmist ja võimekust ringi liikuda - korterite külastused, arstil, tööandja juures käimised jms. Teenusel olevatele inimestele väljasõitude ja ühisürituste korraldamine ja nendel osalemine. Tööle asudes tuleb arvestada, et osa väljaõppest toimub Tartus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meil on hooliv ja kokkuhoidev kollektiiv - jagame ühiselt nii muresid kui rõõme. Elvas on kokkuhoidev kollektiiv. Kord kuus toimuvad asutuse töökoosolekud Tartus. Uutele töötajatele toimuvad uue töötaja koolitused, kus kõik erialaga seotud teemad detailselt läbi käime. Lisaks on olemas mentori ja kvaliteedijuhi tugi.
Võid kindel olla, et see ametikoht arendab Sind. Töö pakub võimalust tunda end vajaliku ja olulisena. Tööalaste väljakutsetega toimetulekuks toimuvad regulaarsed kovisioonid ja supervisioonid. Pakume puhkust suveperioodil ja tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi jõulude ajal ning tasustatud vaba päeva võimalust. Toimuvad ühised väljasõidud õppimise- ja kogemuste saamise eesmärgil. Sul on töö tegemiseks oma kindel töökoht, arvuti ja töö telefoniga. Juhul kui erialane haridus puudub, on võimalik see omandada tööl käimise ajal.

Muud nõuded: Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus.
Sul peab olema valmisolek tööks puuetega inimestega - võimekus toime tulla pingelistes olukordades, kus on vaja rahu säilitada. Väga oluline on iseenda tundmine, võimekus hoida oma vaimset tervist korras. Samuti on vaja osata oma tööd ja tööaega planeerida. Töö eeldab võimekust töötada nii individuaalselt kui meeskonnas. Parimad tulemused tulevad oskusest ja julgusest küsimusi küsida. Kasuks tuleb hea huumorimeel.

We encourage you to apply early, as suitable candidates will be invited to a paid trial day while applications are still open. This gives us a chance to get to know each other and assess your sewing skills, while you get acquainted with our work and studio.

title: Lasteaiaõpetaja abi
description:
Montessori eralasteaias

Tööülesanded: Assistent on rühmas väärtustatud ning väga oluline inimene nii juhendajate kui ka laste jaoks!
Assistent võtab hommikul lapsi naeratuse ja avatud südamega vastu ja sama moodi soojalt saadab nad ka õhtul ära. Oskab jääda tahaplaanile, samal ajal haldab kogu rühma, märkab ja on kohal. Vajadusel suunab lapsi toimetustesse, vajadusel on toeks ning aitab lahendada muresid. Hoolitseb selle eest, et lastel oleks turvaline olla. Aitab luua ettevalmistatud keskkonda, mis toetab laste iseseisvust ja toimetamist rühmas ning abistab juhendajat seal, kus vaja, On avatud loomingulisele tööle. Soovib Montessori metoodikat paremini tundma õppida ja on valmis end selles valdkonnas täiendama Hoiab puhtust ja hügieeni.

Omalt poolt pakume: Inspireerivat tööd, mis ei ole kunagi igav.
Väljaõpet õppinud Montessori juhendaja (AMI 3-6 vanusegrupi) juhendajate käe all ning Montessori teemalisi koolitusi Kokkuhoidvat, rõõmsat, üksteist toetavat meeskonda. Meil on tõesti äge meeskond, ootame Sind! Konkurentsivõimelist palka -täiskoha puhul 1360 eurot (bruto). Koormuse osas on võimalik kokku leppida, võimalus on osaline kui ka täiskohaga töö.

Muud nõuded: Olulisemad märksõnad oleksid lapsest lähtuv, last austav, oled motiveeritud ja lased ennast Montessori meetodist inspireerida.
Väikeses meeskonnas on olulised ausus, täpsus, usaldusväärsus ja kohusetundlikkus. Hea kui märkad ja mõtled kaasa. Oleme kasvav ja arenev lasteaed, kes on olles oma teekonna alguses.

Lapse isikliku elu ja õppetööga seotud ning vaimse tervise probleemidega toimetuleku toetamine ja nõustamine; tunnetusprotsesside, vaimsete võimete, käitumis- ja suhtlemisoskuste arendamise ning õpi- ja karjäärivalikute tegemise toetamine ja nõustamine. ÕIAJK oma vastutusala täitmine; tugispetsialistidega, lapsevanematega; osalemine meeskonnaliikmena kooli arendustöös ja loometegevuses.

Omalt poolt pakume: Võimalust töötada piirkonna suurimas koolis.

title: Office Assistant
description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

title: AV Designer
description:
Big ideas in, flawless shows out. You're the calm voice in the control room – three steps ahead of everyone. Your next stage is at FLIK.

**The role**

FLIK is looking for an AV Designer who understands how live events work from planning to execution.

You combine technical understanding, practical production experience and strong problem-solving skills. You can design reliable technical setups, anticipate issues before production, and find solutions when plans change. You'll be the link between our Event Managers, Designers and Technical team. You'll translate 3D designs and client wishes into workable technical plans, challenge them when needed, and lead the team that brings them to life.

We deliver more than 2,000 IR hybrid events every year across the Nordics through our own platform VideoSync, ranging from simple audiocasts to cutting-edge Virtual AGMs.

**What you'll do**

- Plan technical setups for our studio, on-site and hybrid events

- Anticipate technical risks and solve problems before and during productions

- Prepare plans, budgets, equipment requirements and documentation

- Coordinate with internal teams, customers, freelancers and suppliers

- Participate hands-on in productions and technical operations

- Improve our studio architecture and ways of working

- Take ownership of technical production in our most important events

- Place customer needs first in your decisions


**Technical environment**

You'll work with technologies such as:

- vMix, Madmapper, Lightkey, Companion and other software-based AV tools

- AVoIP protocols such as NDI, Dante, ArtNet, OSC

- PTZ systems, audio systems, automation

- Production networking

- LED volumes, vision mixing

- WebRTC, RTMP and streaming platforms


You don't need to be an expert in everything. We're looking for strong general technical understanding and the ability to see how the pieces work together.

**Who you are**

- Have 5+ years of experience in live production, broadcasting, streaming, events or a similar technical environment

- Understand the whole production chain, not just your own technical area

- Can plan practical solutions based on real production experience

- Think ahead and spot potential problems early

- Take ownership and move things forward without guidance

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills

- Can explain and justify technical choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Want to improve how we work, not just deliver the next production

- Are happy to get your hands dirty and participate in production

- Have fluent English and Finnish skills


**What we offer**

- A high degree of ownership in a flat, self-managed organisation

- A varied role combining planning, problem-solving and hands-on production

- The opportunity to influence our technical environment and processes

- A technically strong and supportive team

- Hybrid work model across our Ruoholahti premises, on-site or remote when applicable

- Opportunities to work across the Nordics and Europe


The position is full-time and permanent. The salary range for this position is €4,000–5,200/month + benefits. Our company benefits include high-end IT equipment, comprehensive health insurance, lunch/activity benefit and share option program opportunities, among others.

**About Inderes**

Inderes' mission is to connect listed companies and investors. Our customer base includes over 400 listed companies that rely on us for better investor communication.

Our Events business delivers over 2,000 online and hybrid events annually across the Nordics. We operate with a high degree of ownership, where teams are flat, decisions are made close to the problem, and roles evolve over time.

Inderes Playbook: https://group.inderes.com/files/documents/Inderes%20Playbook%20v4.pdf

**Application process**

Submit your CV and application via TeamTailor: https://careers.inderes.com/jobs/8455404-av-designer You may apply in Finnish or English.

We're more interested in how you approach technical problems than in polished applications. We'll aim to conduct preliminary Teams interviews, followed by in-person interviews for selected applicants.

The position will be filled when we find the right candidate.

title: Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technician
description:
Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is establishing its Finnish operations in Hyvinkää for the import, storage, logistics, sales and rental of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

The Hyvinkää site includes approximately 10,000 m² of operating and storage area, approximately 300 m² of covered shed/workshop space, and additional container-based storage.

We are recruiting two Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technicians to support and manage the daily handling, inspection, maintenance, storage and inventory control of scaffolding equipment.

This is a technical logistics role requiring previous experience with scaffolding, construction equipment or comparable technical products.

Main responsibilities

\- Receiving, unloading and checking incoming deliveries.

\- Identifying scaffolding components and verifying quantities against shipment documents.

\- Inspecting equipment for damage, wear and defects.

\- Carrying out maintenance, repair and basic metalwork where required.

\- Organising scaffolding equipment in the yard, covered areas and storage containers.

\- Maintaining stock and inventory records.

\- Preparing and loading customer deliveries.

\- Maintaining tools, workshop and storage areas.

\- Supporting the development of warehouse and maintenance processes.

\- Following occupational safety and company procedures.

International coordination

The role includes regular communication with Affix manufacturing, sourcing, supply-chain and back-office teams outside Finland, including teams in India. Coordination may relate to shipments, packing lists, product codes, quality issues, damaged equipment, stock discrepancies, replacement components and delivery planning. Previous experience working with international manufacturing, logistics, sourcing, supply-chain or back-office teams is therefore important.

Required experience and skills

\- Relevant experience with scaffolding, construction equipment, structural-metal products or comparable technical equipment.

\- Experience in inspection, maintenance, repair, warehousing or logistics.

\- Ability to identify components and understand product compatibility.

\- Experience maintaining stock or inventory records.

\- Ability to read shipment and product documentation.

\- Sufficient English for daily international communication.

\- Ability to work independently and perform physically demanding work.

Considered an advantage

\- Experience with Ringlock, Cuplock or similar scaffolding systems.

\- Scaffolding-industry experience.

\- Metalworking or welding skills.

\- Forklift experience.

\- Experience with warehouse-management systems.

\- Car driving licence (Category B).

\- Experience in international import, export or container logistics.

Pre-employment requirement

\- A drug test will be conducted before a final job offer is made.

What we offer

\- Permanent, full-time employment.

\- A key role in establishing Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy's Finnish warehouse, maintenance and logistics operations.

\- International cooperation with Affix teams abroad.

\- Employment terms in accordance with Finnish legislation and the Commerce Sector Collective Agreement.

title: Software Developer
description:
**Would you like to build software that real companies use every day?**

CraftLeap is a software company founded in 2023. We develop easy-to-use software, particularly for **production and inventory management**, for companies in the manufacturing industry. Our product is already in active use by companies across Finland – and now we are looking for our first software developer to join us and help build the next stage of CraftLeap.

Our first customer joined us in 2023. We now have **almost 20 customers, with the majority joining us during this year**. Growth has been strong, and new customers are continuously coming in.

This is an exciting stage to join us if you want to have a real impact on a growing product.

What will you be doing?

You will be developing CraftLeap's web-based software together with the founder. Your work will include, for example:

- designing and implementing new features

- developing user interfaces and functionality

- improving and maintaining existing code

- investigating and fixing bugs

- developing the software based on customer needs

- building new integrations and backend services


As the product continues to grow, you will also have the opportunity to influence **what we build and how we build it**.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We are primarily looking for someone who already has experience in software development and is comfortable taking responsibility for their work.

**Developers at the early stages of their careers are also very welcome to apply.** If you are familiar with software development, learn quickly, and are eager to work on a real software product, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Experience with technologies such as these is a plus:

- **JavaScript or TypeScript**

- **React, Angular, Vue or other modern web development**

- web-based application development

- REST APIs and integrations

- cloud services and cloud-based databases

- Git and modern software development tools


We are not looking for a long list of technologies on your CV. What matters most to us is that **you can build working software and solve problems independently**.

What is it like to work at CraftLeap?

CraftLeap is a small company, so you won't be one developer among a hundred others.

You will work directly with the founder. Decisions can be made quickly, new ideas can be tested, and your work will have a visible impact on the product.

The position is **hybrid, with a strong focus on remote work**. We do, however, hope that you can work together with us in the Seinäjoki area when needed.

There is no unnecessary bureaucracy or complicated organizational structure. If you see something that could be done better, you can say it – and even better if you can help make it happen.

Why join us now?

CraftLeap is at a point where the product is no longer just an idea or a prototype.

**The software is in production, we have customers across Finland, and our customer base is growing rapidly.**

We are now building the foundation for the next stage of growth. As one of the first developers at CraftLeap, you will have a significant role in developing the product and shaping the technical solutions as the development team grows.

Salary and applying

Salary will be agreed based on your experience and skills.

**Please include your salary expectation in your application.**

If this sounds like something you could be a good fit for, **we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement listed above**.

Tell us briefly about yourself, your previous experience and the kind of software you have worked with.

**More information:** craftleap.com

**Applications:** info@craftleap.com

title: Sisustustyönjohtaja
description:
Riverco Oy on keskisuuri konepaja-, laivankorjaus- ja laivanrakennusalan yritys, joka on kansainvälisesti menestynyt ja alallaan tunnettu. Pääasiakkaitamme ovat muun muassa maailman johtavat risteilyvarustamot ja telakat.

Olemme osa erittäin vakavaraista ja 60 vuotta toiminutta monialaista yritysryhmää. Konserni toimii konepaja- ja laivanrakennusteollisuuden lisäksi sähkö- ja putkiurakoinnissa, kiinteistötoimialalla sekä kaupan alalla. Yrityksen toimipaikat sijaitsevat Turussa, Raisiossa, Paraisilla ja Nousiaisissa.

Tyypillisiä työkohteitamme ovat laivojen teknisten ja sisustusalueiden kokonaistoimitukset sekä laivojen tekniset järjestelmät. Toteutamme useille kansainvälisille varustamoille muun muassa vaativia muutos-, kunnossapito- ja huoltotöitä.

Osaavaan tiimiimme olisi nyt haussa kotimaassa ja ulkomailla toteutettaviin laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausprojekteihin:

**SISUSTUSTYÖNJOHTAJA**

**Työnkuva**

Sisustustyönjohtajana vastaat laivojen sisustus- ja muutostöiden käytännön toteutuksesta työmaalla. Johdat ja ohjaat asentajia sekä aliurakoitsijoita ja huolehdit siitä, että työt etenevät suunnitelmien, aikataulujen ja laatutavoitteiden mukaisesti. Ennen projektia osallistut esivalmistuksen ohjaamiseen ja ostotoimintaan.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- työmaan päivittäisen toiminnan ja työn etenemisen suunnittelu ja johtaminen

- oman henkilöstön ja aliurakoitsijoiden työnjohto sekä työn organisointi

- töiden aikatauluttaminen ja resurssien suunnittelu yhdessä projektiryhmän kanssa

- työpiirustusten ja muiden suunnitelmien läpikäynti sekä niiden toteutuksen valvonta

- materiaalien, työkalujen ja muiden työssä tarvittavien resurssien koordinointi

- työn laadun ja aikataulujen valvonta sekä tarvittavien muutosten koordinointi

- projektien valmisteluun, työmäärien arviointiin ja toteutuksen suunnitteluun osallistuminen


Työtehtävät vaihtelevat projektien mukaan, joten työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden olla mukana sekä pienemmissä korjaus- ja muutostöissä että laajemmissa laivanrakennusprojekteissa.

Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista projektiryhmää, mutta tehtävässä korostuu myös itsenäinen ote, päätöksentekokyky ja vastuunotto omasta työmaasta.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Arvostamme soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta tai aikaisempaa kokemusta laivanrakennuksen tai rakennus- ja teollisuudenalan työnjohdosta. Erityisesti kokemus laivojen sisustustöistä, muutostöistä tai telakkaympäristöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- käytännönläheistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- kykyä ohjata erilaisia työryhmiä

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- kykyä lukea teknisiä piirustuksia ja suunnitelmia

- matkustusvalmiutta kotimaassa ja ulkomailla

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen sekä itsenäisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja mielenkiintoisten projektien parissa.

Tehtävässä pääset näkemään projektit alusta loppuun ja osallistumaan niiden valmisteluun, toteutukseen ja viimeistelyyn. Työ tarjoaa vaihtelua, vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista laivanrakennuksen ja laivankorjauksen monipuolisissa tehtävissä.

Työskentelet osana kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista projektiorganisaatiota, jossa yhteistyöllä ja käytännön tekemisellä on tärkeä rooli projektien onnistumisessa.

Jos olet käytännönläheinen, vastuullinen ja yhteistyökykyinen tekijä, joka viihtyy vaihtelevissa työympäristöissä ja haluaa olla mukana toteuttamassa vaativia laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausprojekteja, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

title: HSE Specialist
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

We are looking for a HSE Specialist to join our HSE Team in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support our Finnish projects in the Nordic Operation Unit (OU) and focus on the HSE tasks in the HSE department and throughout the projects life cycle. You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. Through innovation, digitalization and intelligent use of technology, we advance how decisions are made and how projects are executed. We do not simply adapt to change; we actively shape the future of HSE by turning new ideas into practical solutions that enable safer, smarter and more efficient project delivery.

If you are motivated by complex projects, enjoy working with skilled professionals and want to help shape the future of HSE in the energy and construction industries, you will fit right in with our team.

**How you'll make an impact**

\- Implement and work with continuous improvement of Hitachi Energy operating unit management system and local requirements in Finland for the operating unit of the Nordic OU.

\- Prepare and update HSE documentation in accordance with the internal process. Submit all preliminary HSE plans to the customer in accordance with the tender submission dates.

\-Attend clarification meetings and workshops with the customer (both in person and remotely).

\- Prepare the Project HSE Plan as well as other HSE-related documentation such as the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan.

\- Ensure activities under the scope of Hitachi Energy are in compliance with legal and contractual HSE requirements as well as internal HSE requirements.

\- Produce reports for Project Reviews, both internal and customer, and attend the Project Review meetings to ensure the Hitachi Energy HSE Operating System remains suitable, adequate, and effective.

\- Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.

**Your background**

\- Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects

\- Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

\- Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications

\- Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to operate within global teams

\- Self-driven and persistent attitude towards challenges. You work actively and professionally both independently and as a part of a team.

\- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and Finnish. Swedish is seen as a plus.

title: Prosessi-insinööri, Keliber-litiumhanke
description:
Sibanye-Stillwaterin Keliber-litiumhanke on aloittanut Euroopan ensimmäisen omaan malmiin perustuvan akkulaatuisen litiumhydroksidin tuotannon vaiheittaisen käynnistämisen. Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.
Haluatko tarttua ainutlaatuiseen tilaisuuteen ja tulla luomaan uuden sukupolven suomalaista teollisuutta?
Haemme nyt litiumjalostamolle Kokkolaan


PROSESSI-INSINÖÖRIÄ (paineliuotus)
tukemaan käyttöönoton valmistelua. Tuotannon käynnistyttyä olet mukana litiumjalostamon operatiivisessa toiminnassa varmistamassa prosessien turvallista ja tehokasta käyttöä. Raportoit tehtävässäsi litiumjalostamon tehtaanjohtajalle.
Lisäksi tehtäviisi kuuluu
seisokkien ja huoltopysäytysten suunnittelu yhdessä käynnissäpidon kanssa
osallistuminen litiumjalostamon vuosibudjetointiin ja kustannusten seurantaan
tuotannon operaattoreiden koulutus, ohjeistukset ja riskinarviot
tiivis yhteistyö jalostamon operaattoreiden ja insinöörien kanssa

Odotamme sinulta
kemian, prosessi- tai konetekniikan korkeakoulututkintoa
työkokemusta (vähintään 5 vuotta) autoklaavi- tai paineliuotusprosessista
erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä suomen että englannin kielellä.


Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan, hyvät työsuhde-edut sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittyä ammatillisesti osana kunnianhimoista ja innostunutta työyhteisöä. Meillä turvallisuus on aina etusijalla, ja teollisuusyrityksenä kiinnitämme erityistä huomiota ympäristöasioiden kestävään hoitamiseen. Ymmärrämme työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamisen merkityksen hyvinvoinnille, jota tuemme mm. liukuvalla työajalla ja mahdollistamalla etätyö työtehtävien salliessa.
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa litiumjalostamon Tehtaanjohtaja Heikki Pihlaja, puh. 050 363 7324, heikki.pihlaja@sibanyestillwater.com
Hae tehtävään 25.10.2026 mennessä.


Sibanye-Stillwaters Keliber lithium project has begun the phased ramp-up of Europes first battery-grade lithium hydroxide production based on its own ore. The operation covers the entire value chain from ore exploration to lithium hydroxide processing and strengthens Europes battery value chain. The concentrator is located in Päiväneva, Kaustinen, and the lithium refinery is in the Kokkola industrial park.
Lithium hydroxide is a key raw material in lithium-ion batteries, which power electric vehicles, energy storage, and many everyday digital solutions.
Keliber is a subsidiary of Sibanye-Stillwater, a multinational mining and metals processing Group, with Finnish Minerals Group as the second largest shareholder, a state-owned company developing the value chain of lithium-ion batteries.
Would you like to take on this unique chance and create new generations industry in Finland?

We are now looking for a



PROCESS ENGINEER (pressure leaching)

to support preparations for operational readiness. Once production begins, you will be involved in the day-to-day operations of the lithium refinery, ensuring the safe and efficient operation of the processes. You report to the refinery's site manager.

In addition, your duties include:

Planning outages and maintenance stops in collaboration with maintenance
Participating in annual budgeting and cost monitoring
Training operators, making guidelines and risk assessments
Close collaboration with refinery operators and engineers

In order to succeed, we expect You to:
Have a Masters/Bachelors degree in chemical, process or mechanical engineering
Have minimum 5 years work experience in autoclave or pressure leaching process
Have excellent cooperation skills both in Finnish and English


In addition to competitive salary and good benefits, we offer excellent opportunities for professional development in an ambitious and exciting work community. For us, safety is always a priority, and as an industrial company we give special attention to handling environmental matters sustainably. We understand the significance of balance between work and private life and support this for example with flexible working hours and providing the option for remote work when possible.
For further information please contact Vice President, Lithium Refinery Heikki Pihlaja, tel. +358 (0)50 363 7324, heikki.pihlaja@sibanyestillwater.

Apply by 25 October 2026

title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
description:
Asiakuuspäällikkö, Oulu / Pohjois-Pohjanmaa

Haemme TEPJO tekijöille asiakuuspäällikköä vahvistamaan myyntiämme Oulun/Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueelle!
Oletko tavoitteellinen jo kokemusta omaava myynnin ammattilainen, joka viihtyy asiakasrajapinnassa ja haluaa rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita? Etsimme nyt asiakkuuspäällikköä vastaamaan henkilöstöpalveluiden myynnistä ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä Oulun alueella.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään erityisesti rakennus-, infra- ja teollisuusalan asiakasyritysten parissa ja rakentamaan ratkaisuja heidän henkilöstötarpeisiinsa.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat alueesi asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja henkilöstöpalveluiden myynnistä. Työsi on monipuolinen yhdistelmä uusasiakashankintaa, aktiivista asiakastyötä ja pitkäaikaisten kumppanuuksien rakentamista.
Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:
- uusien asiakkuuksien aktiivinen hankinta ja myyntityö
- potentiaalisten asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja tapaamisten sopiminen
- nykyisten asiakassuhteiden ylläpito ja kehittäminen
- asiakkaiden henkilöstötarpeiden kartoittaminen ja niihin sopivien ratkaisujen tarjoaminen
- tarjousten ja sopimusten tekeminen
- oman alueen asiakkuuksien ja myynnin tavoitteellinen kehittäminen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on aikaisempaa kokemusta henkilöstöalan myyntitehtävistä ja ymmärrystä henkilöstöpalveluiden toimintaympäristöstä.
Toivomme sinulta:
- kokemusta B2B-myynnistä ja uusasiakashankinnasta
- mielellään aiempaa kokemusta henkilöstöpalveluiden myynnistä, rekrytoinnista tai vastaavista tehtävistä
- aktiivinen ja tavoitteellinen ote tekemiseen
- hyvät neuvottelu- ja vuorovaikutustaidot
- kyky rakentaa ja ylläpitää pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita
- itsenäinen ja oma-aloitteinen työskentelyote
Rakennus-, infra- tai teollisuusalan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on vahva myynnillinen ote ja ymmärrys henkilöstöpalvelualasta.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden ottaa vastuuta ja rakentaa merkittävää roolia kasvavalla Oulun ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan markkina-alueella.
Tarjoamme:
- kannustavan ja avoimen työympäristön, missä on oikeasti mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhönsä
- palkka 3 400–4 500 €/kk kokemuksesta ja osaamisesta riippuen
- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman alueesi asiakkuuksiin ja myynnin kehittämiseen
- monipuolisen ja itsenäisen työnkuvan
- mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakkuuksia ja kasvattaa omaa verkostoasi
- ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä henkilöstöpalvelualan myynnin ammattilaisena.
- loistavan työilmapiirin

TEPJO tekijät on Pohjois-Pohjanmaalla toimiva henkilöstöratkaisujen ammattilainen, joka on erikoistunut tarjoamaan laadukasta työvoimaa rakennus-, teollisuus-, logistiikka- sekä kaupanalan tarpeisiin.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja sinulla on näyttöjä henkilöstöalan myynnistä, haluamme kuulla sinusta!
Lähetä meille CV ja hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Kerro hakemuksessasi lyhyesti aiemmasta myyntikokemuksestasi, saavutuksistasi sekä siitä, miksi juuri tämä tehtävä kiinnostaa sinua.
Tule rakentamaan kanssamme kasvua Oulun ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueella!

title: Moduliverstaan työnjohtaja
description:
Riverco Oy on keskisuuri konepaja-, laivankorjaus- ja laivanrakennusalan yritys, joka on kansainvälisesti menestynyt ja alallaan tunnettu. Pääasiakkaitamme ovat muun muassa maailman johtavat risteilyvarustamot ja telakat.

Olemme osa erittäin vakavaraista ja 60 vuotta toiminutta monialaista yritysryhmää. Konserni toimii konepaja- ja laivanrakennusteollisuuden lisäksi sähkö- ja putkiurakoinnissa, kiinteistötoimialalla sekä kaupan alalla. Yrityksen toimipaikat sijaitsevat Turussa, Raisiossa, Paraisilla ja Nousiaisissa.

Tyypillisiä työkohteitamme ovat laivojen teknisten ja sisustusalueiden kokonaistoimitukset sekä laivojen tekniset järjestelmät. Toteutamme useille kansainvälisille varustamoille muun muassa vaativia muutos-, kunnossapito- ja huoltotöitä.

Osaavaan tiimiimme olisi nyt haussa:

**MODULIVERSTAAN TYÖNJOHTAJA**

Moduliverstaan työnjohtajana vastaat metalli- ja sisustusesivalmisteiden sekä erilaisten modulien valmistuksesta ja korjausprojekteista. Vastaat verstaan päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta, töiden organisoinnista ja tuotannon etenemisestä. Tehtävässä johdat ja ohjaat verstaan henkilöstöä sekä huolehdit siitä, että työt toteutetaan suunnitelmien, aikataulujen ja laatutavoitteiden mukaisesti. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektipäälliköiden sekä suunnittelijoiden kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa työn resursointi ja aikataulutus, materiaalien ja valmistuksen koordinointi, työn laadun valvonta sekä tuotannon ongelmatilanteiden ratkaiseminen. Osallistut myös töiden esivalmisteluun sekä ostotoimintaan.

Arvostamme soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta tai kokemusta verstaan, tuotannon tai teollisuuden työnjohdollisista tehtävistä. Kokemus laivanrakennuksesta katsotaan eduksi. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää käytännönläheistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta, hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä ottaa vastuuta ja tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen sekä itsenäisen ja monipuolisen työn. Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään osana kansainvälistä laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausliiketoimintaa sekä kehittää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisessa tuotanto- ja projektitoimintaympäristössä.

title: Product Engineer (Mechanical Design), Dieffenbacher / Lahti, Nastola
description:
About the role

Dieffenbacher is a German, globally operating machinery manufacturer focusing on the design and manufacture of press systems and complete production lines for the panel industry.

In this role, you will play a key part as a member of a \~20-person mechanical design team in Nastola. You will be responsible for specific equipment entities and perform related design work. You will work in close cooperation with automation designers and the chief mechanical designer to ensure projects progress smoothly. Additionally, you will guide external consultants and ensure the quality of the work.

Every project brings something new, giving you the opportunity to challenge yourself with new practices and possibilities.

Why Join Us?
Our mechanical engineering relies strongly on our own expert know-how and a broad network of specialists. We offer you a responsible and diverse role where you can solve interesting technical challenges. With us, you will work in a close-knit atmosphere from the drafting board straight into practice.

Work tasks
- Equipment Responsibility: You will be responsible for designated equipment packages, overseeing equipment improvements, cost tracking, supporting project planning, and equipment documentation.
- Design: You will design custom customer assignments (heavy structures) using Creo & AutoCAD.
- Quality Assurance and Partner Guidance: You will direct design work done by consultants and ensure the output meets high quality standards.
- Practical Collaboration and Inspections: You will collaborate with the workshops, automation design, and R&D, perform equipment inspections, and communicate with customers as needed.
- Fieldwork: You will participate in troubleshooting at installation sites when necessary (site visits approx. 5–15 days per year).

We are looking for

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.
- Solid design experience (preferably over 4 years) in heavy structures (1–20 t), machinery, and machine parts manufactured by welding or machining.
- Fluent English skills.
- Ability to work full-time at the Nastola office during the trial period. Option for 2 remote workdays per week after the trial period.
- Readiness to travel abroad approx. 5–15 days per year.
- Accountability, a proactive and precise working style, and good interpersonal skills.

Considered an Advantage:
- Good proficiency in Finnish.
- Understanding the requirements and possibilities of different manufacturing methods.
- Experience in structural strength calculations and motor sizing.
- Previous hands-on experience in welding or installation work.

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
For our client in the banking sector we are looking for a Senior Mobile Developer / Mobile Tech Lead – iOS & Android.

The consultant will be responsible for driving the UI uplift and modernization of the mobile banking applications while working hands-on with both iOS and Android development.

Key responsibilities include:
- Lead UI improvement initiatives, ensuring a modern, consistent, and user-friendly experience across mobile platforms.
- Design, develop, and maintain features for iOS and Android applications.
- Collaborate with designers, architects, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
- Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design, and development best practices.
- Ensure high quality through code reviews, unit testing, UI automation, and continuous improvement activities.
- Take ownership of delivered solutions, including implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
- Support the team in end-to-end deliveries, including frontend and backend contributions when needed.
- The consultant is expected to combine technical leadership with hands-on development and play a key role in improving the user experience of digital banking services.

Must-have knowledge and experience:
- 7+ years of professional experience in mobile application development with a proven track record of delivering large-scale mobile solutions.
- Strong expertise in either iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin), combined with strong hands-on experience in the other platform.
- Experience leading or driving UI modernization, redesign, or uplift initiatives in mobile applications. - Strong knowledge of mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM, VIPER, or similar.
- Experience with UIKit, Auto Layout, Jetpack Compose, XML layouts, and Fragments.
- Strong understanding of unit testing, UI test automation, and quality engineering practices on mobile platforms.
- Experience integrating and consuming REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and background processing.
- Experience working with secure, high-quality, customer-facing applications where performance, stability, and security are critical.
- Ability to drive technical discussions, collaborate with designers and stakeholders, and take ownership of end-to-end deliveries.
- Strong communication skills and experience working in agile cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-have knowledge and experience:
- Banking, payments, or financial services experience.
- Experience with design systems, accessibility, and mobile UX best practices.
- Knowledge of web technologies such as Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have 7+ years of professional experience in mobile application development?*
- Do you have strong professional experience in either iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin), as well as hands-on development experience with the other platform?*i
- Have you led or played a key role in a mobile UI modernization, redesign, or uplift initiative?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with both iOS UI technologies (UIKit/Auto Layout) and Android UI technologies (Jetpack Compose/XML)?*
- Do you have experience with mobile unit testing and UI test automation in production applications?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

title: Voimisteluohjaaja
description:
Etsimme Voimistelukoulu Vilkkaaseen iloista ja reipasta voimisteluohjaajaa lasten ryhmien ohjaamiseen.

Voimisteluohjaajana vastaat lasten voimistelutuntien sujuvasta ja turvallisesta toteutuksesta. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu alkulämmittelyjen ja loppuvenyttelyjen ohjaaminen sekä erilaisten voimisteluliikkeiden ja -taitojen opettaminen lapsille heidän ikä- ja taitotasonsa huomioiden.

Toivomme sinulta positiivista ja kannustavaa asennetta, hyviä ryhmänhallintataitoja sekä tehokasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen lapsi kokee olevansa osa ryhmää ja pääsee harjoittelemaan kannustavassa ja yhteisöllisessä ilmapiirissä.

Aikaisempi kokemus voimistelusta, liikunnasta tai lasten ohjaamisesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on innostus lasten kanssa työskentelyyn sekä halu oppia ja kehittyä ohjaajana.

title: Ajoneuvovarustelija
description:
**Hifix Oy hakee ajoneuvovarustelijaa osaksi kasvavaa tiimiämme!**

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja oma-aloitteista ajoneuvovarustelijaa, joka nauttii käsillä tekemisestä ja haluaa työskennellä monipuolisten hyötyajoneuvojen varustelutehtävien parissa.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu erilaisten paketti- ja hyötyajoneuvojen varustelua asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan. Työ on vaihtelevaa ja sisältää sekä valmiiden tuotteiden asentamista että yksilöllisten ratkaisujen rakentamista.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:**

- hyötyajoneuvojen varustelu ja kalustaminen

- työkaluhyllyjen, laatikostojen ja muiden säilytysratkaisujen asennukset

- vanerointi ja ajoneuvojen sisätilojen rakentaminen

- kattotelineiden, astinlautojen ja muiden varusteiden asennukset

- lisävalojen ja muiden ajoneuvojen sähkövarusteiden asennukset

- erilaisten rakenteiden valmistus ja sovittaminen ajoneuvoihin

- asiakkaiden tilaamien yksilöllisten varusteluratkaisujen toteuttaminen

- tarvittaessa myös muut ajoneuvojen varusteluun ja asennukseen liittyvät työtehtävät


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme sinulta ennen kaikkea hyvää tekemisen meininkiä, huolellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta.

Arvostamme kykyä ratkaista käytännön ongelmia ja halua oppia uusia asioita.

Aikaisempi kokemus ajoneuvojen varustelusta on eduksi, mutta tehtävään voidaan kouluttaa sopiva tekijä, jolla on vahva käytännön osaaminen ja kiinnostus alaan.

**Eduksi katsomme erityisesti**

- kokemuksen hyötyajoneuvojen varustelusta

- puuntyöstötaidot ja kokemuksen vaneritöistä

- laiterakennus- ja metallityötaidot

- ajoneuvosähköjen tuntemuksen

- kokemuksen sähköasennuksista ja 12 V järjestelmistä

- teknisen piirustuksen lukutaidon

- hyvän työkalujen ja koneiden tuntemuksen


**Millainen henkilö sopii meille?**

Olet käytännönläheinen tekijä, joka haluaa nähdä oman työnsä lopputuloksen. Osaat käyttää erilaisia käsityökaluja ja koneita, etkä säikähdä uusia tai haastavia asennustehtäviä.

Meillä arvostetaan erityisesti sitä, että työntekijä pystyy miettimään itse ratkaisuja ja viemään työn alusta loppuun huolellisesti.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Hifix Oy:llä pääset tekemään monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa työtä hyötyajoneuvojen varustelun parissa. Työkohteet vaihtelevat ja työssä pääsee toteuttamaan sekä valmiita varustelukokonaisuuksia että asiakkaiden yksilöllisiä ratkaisuja.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista monipuolisesti autojen, rakentamisen, sähköjen ja teknisten ratkaisujen parissa.

**Työsuhde**: vakituinen

**Työpaikka:** Lahti

**Aloitus**: sopimuksen mukaan

**Palkkaus**: sopimuksen mukaan / kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaista käytännön osaamista sinulla on.
