title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Vaasaan
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Vaasan alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Poriin
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Porin alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

title: Yoga & Wellness Instructor
description:
Are you passionate about wellness, outdoor activities, and creating memorable guest experiences? Join the team at **Halo Igloos Resort** and work in the heart of Finnish Lapland, surrounded by breathtaking Arctic nature.

We are currently looking for a **Yoga & Wellness Instructor** for the winter season 2026-2027.

Employment Details

- Fixed-term employment from **1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027**

- Start date: **1 November 2026 or as agreed**

- Minimum working hours: **90 hours per 3-week period**

- **Starting salary: €14/hour**

- The employment relationship is subject to the **Program Services Sector Collective Agreement**


Key Responsibilities

Your primary role will be to plan and deliver wellness experiences for our international guests. Duties include:

- Leading yoga classes for guests of varying experience levels

- Organizing and conducting outdoor wellness and fitness activities

- Developing and delivering wellness products and experiences

- Maintaining the cleanliness and overall upkeep of the wellness facilities

- Guest transportation when required

- Assisting with other operational tasks within the resort


What We Expect

- Experience in teaching yoga and/or leading wellness activities

- A positive, energetic, and self-motivated attitude

- Strong customer service and communication skills

- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

- Good command of English; additional languages are considered an advantage

What We Offer

- A unique opportunity to work in an international hospitality environment

- An inspiring workplace in the stunning nature of Finnish Lapland

- A varied and rewarding role combining wellness, hospitality, and outdoor activities

- The opportunity to contribute to the development of our wellness offerings

title: Svenskspråkig vårdare åt sympatisk kund i Östersundom
description:
**Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**

Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund i Östresundom

Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!

Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**

Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Vad gör en vård helppare?**

En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.

Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

- hjälp vid dusch

- uppföljning av hur senioren mår

- stöd för att klara sig hemma

- stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet


Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.

**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**

Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.

Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.

Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?

Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:

Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.

Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.

Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.

Som vård helppare får du:

- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap.

- **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka.

- **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning.

- **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön!


Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.

**Skicka in din ansökan som vårdare-helpper här.**

**Läs mer om Hemby genom att klicka här.**

Om du har frågor om att bli vårdare-helpper, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

title: Secondary Engineer
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as hydrogen, data centers and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

**The Opportunity**

We are offering a position as a Secondary Engineer at Hitachi Energy, Grid Integration business. This role will be in Vaasa, where we have the team and an office.

The business unit designs and delivers complete substations for distribution and transmission grids. We are offering an interesting position in an international project environment and various development possibilities in the areas of design and engineering, research, and development. Because each project is different, your responsibilities will range widely and may include managing all aspects of secondary design from initial planning to final delivery.

Daily responsibilities include preparing design drawings, drafting essential construction documents, conducting engineering calculations, and overseeing commissioning processes. At Hitachi Energy, you will have the opportunity to apply your design expertise across diverse projects, both domestically in Finland and internationally.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

**\-** Prepare and review substation documentations, for example, single line diagram, protection diagrams, interlocking diagrams, AC and DC drawings, calculations, control and protection panel drawings, IED configurations, cabling and bills of materials.

\- Provide technical evaluation of supplier proposals and accepts as fit for purpose supplied equipment or services.

\- Provide technical support during pre-FAT and FAT stage, handling installation and commissioning activities. Prepare project documentation within one's scope of deliverables.

\- Participate in testing and commissioning.

\- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including project manager, design (Lead, Primary, Civil and commissioning), planner, quality assurance, and supply chain, to ensure seamless project integration and successful outcomes in international project environment.

\- Drive a culture of continuous improvement, fostering innovation, and encouraging employee involvement in problem-solving and process enhancement.

\- Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues, and the business.

**Your background**

\- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

\- Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Finnish or Swedish.

\- Demonstrated proactivity, results orientation, strong interpersonal and teamwork abilities.

\- Willingness to participate in international projects.

\- Willingness to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.

\- Previous experience in engineering work related to high and medium voltage substations is considered an asset.

\- Experience in design software such as E3, AutoCAD, PCM600 is considered as an advantage.

\- Understanding of substation control and protection systems is also considered beneficial.

title: MORS Software : Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Type**: Full-time and permanent

**Location**: Helsinki, Aleksanterinkatu 48

**Application deadline**: 20.10.2026

**Looking for a role where you can take real ownership and help shape the next generation of business-critical fintech software?**

MORS Software develops Treasury Management and Asset & Liability Management software for banks. The product is evolving from a primarily desktop architecture toward a browser-based experience, a durable application/API layer and governed AI/agentic capabilities through MORSia.

Now, MORS is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to join its growing engineering team.

**What will you be doing?**

As a Senior Software Engineer at MORS, you will take end-to-end ownership of key areas of its treasury and banking software. Your work will be backend-focused, with C#/.NET at the core, and will combine work on established production systems with building new solutions. Roughly 60% of the work focuses on the existing product and architecture and 40% on new development.

Your initial focus will be on Financial Planning and Payments, where you will take ownership of existing functionality while contributing to their continued development. Over time, your scope may expand into other areas of MORSs banking software.

Ownership here means more than implementing predefined tickets. You will work with Product and domain specialists to understand the underlying business problem, design the solution, implement and test it, take it to production, investigate issues, and improve it further. You will also have room to challenge existing approaches and influence technical and architectural decisions together with MORS's CTO and engineering team. **What makes you a great fit?**

You are an experienced backend engineer who enjoys taking responsibility for complex software rather than focusing only on an isolated part of the development cycle. You can navigate an established codebase, make pragmatic technical decisions, and move work forward independently even when every requirement has not been defined upfront.

You do not need previous banking experience, but you should be interested in understanding why the software exists and what it enables for customers. MORS values engineers who communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and remain curious as development practices and technologies evolve.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 5 years of professional experience with C#/.NET and strong backend development skills

- Experience owning, debugging, and developing established production software and business-critical functionality

- Strong SQL Server and data access skills, combined with a good understanding of REST APIs and systems integration

- Experience with automated testing, source control, and CI/CD as part of professional software development

- Good English skills and the ability to plan work independently, identify dependencies, and communicate technical risks clearly


**Additional skills we value:**

- Experience with banking, payments, treasury, ALM, or another regulated or business-critical software environment

- Familiarity with Azure and modern ASP.NET Core

- Hands-on knowledge of modernizing legacy .NET applications, including WPF-based systems

- Understanding of batch processing, long-running jobs, workflows, or audit-sensitive systems


**What MORS offers you:**

- Take real ownership of business-critical software, with the autonomy to influence technical decisions and how your areas evolve

- Play a key role in MORSs technical modernization, working with both established systems and new architecture

- Develop deep expertise in banking technology by solving complex problems across Financial Planning, Payments, treasury, and risk management

- Grow your scope as the engineering team expands, with room to take on broader responsibilities and influence technical decisions

- Explore new ways of building software, including AI-assisted development, while having a say in how these tools are adopted


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by MORS Software. The position is based in Helsinki, with the current hybrid model typically involving around two-three days per week at MORS's office at Aleksanterinkatu 48. At the beginning of the employment we hope you will primarily work at the office. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible, taking the selected candidate's notice period into account. Salary in this position is 5500-7500 €/month depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Recruitment process timeline:**

- _Initial video interviews with aTalent: week 43_

- _We will notify all candidates about the next steps by week 44 at the latest_

- _Interview rounds with MORS: week 44 – week 45_


**Interested in taking ownership of what comes next at MORS?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 20th of October via our application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/387497/create/.

A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with MORS Software here: https://morssoftware.com/. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (+358 44 783 5666, veera.kokko\[at\]atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Svenskspråkig barnvakt för en barnfamilj i Åbo
description:
Vill du ha ett meningsfullt och flexibelt deltidsarbete där du får hjälpa barnfamiljer som behöver stöd i vardagen? Då kanske du är vår nästa **helppare**!

Oavsett om du är studerande inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen, pensionär eller en erfaren yrkesperson med utbildning inom social- och hälsovård, är det din entusiasm och genuina vilja att hjälpa till med stort hjärta som är det viktigaste i den här rollen!

Vi är Hemby – ett företag som modigt förnyar hemtjänsten för äldre, barn och egentligen människor i alla åldrar som behöver hjälp i vardagen. Vi vill skapa glädje och trygghet i våra kunders vardag, och vårt motto är: **vi hjälper som om det vore vår egen mamma, pappa, vän eller vårt eget barn.**

Vad är en helppare?

En helppare är en person som erbjuder praktisk hjälp och sällskap till en person som behöver stöd i vardagen, till exempel ett barn. Helpparen hjälper kunden med olika vardagssysslor, såsom att gå ut, delta i dagliga aktiviteter, ta ut soporna eller helt enkelt finnas där som sällskap och hjälpa till.

Med tiden kan helpparen, kunden och kundens familj få en nära och förtroendefull relation.

Alla som är över 18 år kan arbeta som helppare – från studerande till pensionärer. Det viktigaste är en positiv inställning till arbetet och en genuin vilja att hjälpa andra.

Vi söker utbildade yrkespersoner inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen till vårt team för att hjälpa barnfamiljer

Våra kunder är både barn och barnfamiljer. I den här rollen får du stötta barnfamiljer i en hektisk vardag genom att erbjuda din värdefulla tid och hjälpa till med sådant som får vardagen att fungera.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan vara allt från att leka med barnen och gå ut tillsammans till hushållssysslor, såsom att ta ut soporna. Ibland kan besöken helt enkelt bestå av att göra något tillsammans, till exempel färglägga i en målarbok.

Vad krävs av en helppare?

Framför allt en genuin vilja att hjälpa andra. Våra helppare förenas av viljan att tillbringa tid med människor som behöver stöd.

I det här arbetet får du möjlighet att på riktigt påverka och göra våra kunders vardag bättre och enklare. Vi ser det som en extra merit om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barnfamiljer!

Vad är det bästa med att arbeta som helppare?

Vi frågade våra helppare, och så här svarade de:

Att få möta människor utan stress och bli vän med kunden.

Att hjälpa någon annan och känna att arbetet är meningsfullt.

Att få vara en del av Helppar-gemenskapen.

Som helppare får du:

- **En egen namngiven kund**, som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och finns där som sällskap.

- **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt att kombinera med exempelvis studier eller ett annat deltidsarbete. Den typiska arbetstiden är 1–2 gånger i veckan, några timmar åt gången.

- **Konkurrenskraftig timlön:** 13,20–15,98 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning.

- **Goda möjligheter att utvecklas:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro-helppare eller guru-helppare och få högre lön!


Om du har frågor om att bli helppare, skicka ett mejl till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

Straffregisterutdrag som krävs för arbetet

- För arbete med barn krävs ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om kontroll av brottslig bakgrund hos personer som arbetar med barn (504/2002).

title: HSE Specialist
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

We are looking for a HSE Specialist to join our HSE Team in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support our Finnish projects in the Nordic Operation Unit (OU) and focus on the HSE tasks in the HSE department and throughout the projects life cycle. You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. Through innovation, digitalization and intelligent use of technology, we advance how decisions are made and how projects are executed. We do not simply adapt to change; we actively shape the future of HSE by turning new ideas into practical solutions that enable safer, smarter and more efficient project delivery.

If you are motivated by complex projects, enjoy working with skilled professionals and want to help shape the future of HSE in the energy and construction industries, you will fit right in with our team.

**How you'll make an impact**

\- Implement and work with continuous improvement of Hitachi Energy operating unit management system and local requirements in Finland for the operating unit of the Nordic OU.

\- Prepare and update HSE documentation in accordance with the internal process. Submit all preliminary HSE plans to the customer in accordance with the tender submission dates.

\-Attend clarification meetings and workshops with the customer (both in person and remotely).

\- Prepare the Project HSE Plan as well as other HSE-related documentation such as the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan.

\- Ensure activities under the scope of Hitachi Energy are in compliance with legal and contractual HSE requirements as well as internal HSE requirements.

\- Produce reports for Project Reviews, both internal and customer, and attend the Project Review meetings to ensure the Hitachi Energy HSE Operating System remains suitable, adequate, and effective.

\- Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.

**Your background**

\- Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects

\- Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

\- Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications

\- Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to operate within global teams

\- Self-driven and persistent attitude towards challenges. You work actively and professionally both independently and as a part of a team.

\- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and Finnish. Swedish is seen as a plus.

title: Looking for an Arabic cuisine chef
description:

title: Tarjoilija
description:
Etsimme reipasta, asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja hyvällä asenteella varustettua **Tarjoilijaa** hotelliravintolan tiimiin.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisessa hotelliyhteisössä, jossa päivät vaihtelevat aamiaisista lounaisiin, à la carte -tarjoiluun sekä erilaisiin tilaisuuksiin. Olet tärkeä osa asiakkaan viihtyisää ja onnistunutta hotellielämystä.

**Tehtäviisi kuuluu**

- asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja ystävällinen palvelu

- ruoka- ja juomatarjoilu

- tilausten vastaanottaminen ja kassatyöskentely

- ravintolan siisteydestä ja viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen

- aamiaisen, lounaan ja muiden ravintolapalveluiden toteuttaminen

- osallistuminen kokous- ja juhlatilaisuuksien järjestämiseen

- yhteistyö keittiön ja muun hotellihenkilökunnan kanssa


**Toivomme sinulta**

- aikaisempaa kokemusta tarjoilijan tai asiakaspalvelun tehtävistä

- reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja palveluasennetta

- kykyä työskennellä kiireessä ja muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja mielellään myös englannin kielen osaamista

- hygieniapassia ja anniskelupassia tai valmiutta niiden suorittamiseen


Hotellin ravintolassa työskentelyssä arvostamme erityisesti joustavuutta, tiimihenkeä ja halua tehdä asiakkaan päivästä hieman parempi.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn viihtyisässä työympäristössä, mukavan työyhteisön sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi hotelliravintolan eri tehtävissä. Työ on vuorotyötä ja sisältää myös ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja.

**Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille itsestäsi. Työ alkaa sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

**_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._ **_Lue lisää sivustoltamme Staffgate.fi_**

title: Vastaanottovirkailija
description:
Etsimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja reipasta työntekijää hotellin vastaanottoon**.**

Tehtävässä olet tärkeä osa asiakkaiden hotellielämystä ja huolehdit siitä, että vierailu sujuu alusta loppuun mahdollisimman hyvin.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi**

- asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja uloskirjaaminen

- varausten käsittely ja asiakasneuvonta

- asiakkaiden kysymyksiin vastaaminen ja ongelmatilanteiden ratkaiseminen

- puhelin- ja sähköpostiasiakaspalvelu

- yhteistyö siivouksen ja muun hotellihenkilökunnan kanssa

- muut hotellin päivittäiseen toimintaan liittyvät tehtävät.


Työ sisältää **aamu-, ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja**, joten edellytämme valmiutta vuorotyöhön.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Olet ystävällinen, oma-aloitteinen ja luotettava. Viihdyt ihmisten parissa ja pystyt säilyttämään rauhallisen otteen myös kiireisissä tilanteissa.

Aikaisempi kokemus hotellialalta tai asiakaspalvelutehtävistä on välttämätön.

Suomen ja englannin kielen taito on tehtävässä tärkeää. Muu kielitaito katsotaan **eduksi.**

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn hotellialalla, mukavan työyhteisön ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä osana kasvavaa organisaatiota.

Työ sopii hyvin henkilölle, joka pitää vaihtelevista työpäivistä, asiakaspalvelusta ja siitä, että jokainen työpäivä on hieman erilainen.

Laita hakemuksesi meille, ja keskustellaan lisää. Työ alkaa loka-marraskuun vaihteessa.

title: IAM Senior Specialist (EUS)
description:
**Outokumpu is looking for Senior Specialist** for **Identity and Access Management (IAM)** to drive the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of secure, scalable, and future-ready IAM solutions.

**Purpose of the role** **As an IAM Senior Specialist**, you will play a critical role in shaping Outokumpus Identity and Access Management landscape. You will ensure that IAM solutions support business needs, follow security and compliance requirements, and align with modern cyber security and zero trust principles.

**Key accountabilities**

- Develop and maintain IAM architecture, tools, technology selections, and roadmaps in cooperation with Service Managers and other architects.

- Act as a subject matter expert for IAM solutions, providing guidance and support to IT, OT, and other business stakeholders.

- Participate in IT architectural governance and translate business requirements into secure and scalable technical solutions.

- Provide hands-on L2/L3 operational support for IAM solutions when needed.

- Ensure IAM solutions meet established cyber security, compliance, and zero trust standards.

- Stay up to date with industry best practices and emerging IAM technologies, incorporating them into the IAM landscape.

- Collaborate closely with internal teams and external technology providers to provide technical direction and ensure effective service delivery.

- Deep understanding the joiner-leavers-movers processess

- Option for on-call if needed


**Job requirements**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science or a relevant field, or equivalent experience from a similar role.

- Several years of experience in IAM/IGA, with strong hands-on configuration and development experience in IAM services.

- Strong knowledge of Entra ID and Active Directory; PAM experience is considered an advantage.

- Good understanding of cyber security, zero trust principles, integrations, and enterprise environments such as SAP.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with fluent written and spoken English. Other languages are considered a benefit.


**Seen as a plus**

We are looking for a proactive and independent professional who can take initiative, work across teams, and provide clear technical guidance in a complex IT environment. Experience with ITIL processes and ServiceDesk operations is considered a benefit.

**What Outokumpu offers**

- A key role in a global company and modern IT environment

- Opportunity to develop and improve global end user services

- Collaborative colleagues and support from the wider IT organization

- Opportunities for learning, knowledge sharing and professional growth

- Flexible working practices, including hybrid work (50/50)


**Please submit your application by 25th October.**

**The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment**

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
For our client in the banking sector we are looking for a Senior Mobile Developer / Mobile Tech Lead – iOS & Android.

The consultant will be responsible for driving the UI uplift and modernization of the mobile banking applications while working hands-on with both iOS and Android development.

Key responsibilities include:
- Lead UI improvement initiatives, ensuring a modern, consistent, and user-friendly experience across mobile platforms.
- Design, develop, and maintain features for iOS and Android applications.
- Collaborate with designers, architects, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
- Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design, and development best practices.
- Ensure high quality through code reviews, unit testing, UI automation, and continuous improvement activities.
- Take ownership of delivered solutions, including implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
- Support the team in end-to-end deliveries, including frontend and backend contributions when needed.
- The consultant is expected to combine technical leadership with hands-on development and play a key role in improving the user experience of digital banking services.

Must-have knowledge and experience:
- 7+ years of professional experience in mobile application development with a proven track record of delivering large-scale mobile solutions.
- Strong expertise in either iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin), combined with strong hands-on experience in the other platform.
- Experience leading or driving UI modernization, redesign, or uplift initiatives in mobile applications. - Strong knowledge of mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM, VIPER, or similar.
- Experience with UIKit, Auto Layout, Jetpack Compose, XML layouts, and Fragments.
- Strong understanding of unit testing, UI test automation, and quality engineering practices on mobile platforms.
- Experience integrating and consuming REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and background processing.
- Experience working with secure, high-quality, customer-facing applications where performance, stability, and security are critical.
- Ability to drive technical discussions, collaborate with designers and stakeholders, and take ownership of end-to-end deliveries.
- Strong communication skills and experience working in agile cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-have knowledge and experience:
- Banking, payments, or financial services experience.
- Experience with design systems, accessibility, and mobile UX best practices.
- Knowledge of web technologies such as Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have 7+ years of professional experience in mobile application development?*
- Do you have strong professional experience in either iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin), as well as hands-on development experience with the other platform?*i
- Have you led or played a key role in a mobile UI modernization, redesign, or uplift initiative?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with both iOS UI technologies (UIKit/Auto Layout) and Android UI technologies (Jetpack Compose/XML)?*
- Do you have experience with mobile unit testing and UI test automation in production applications?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

title: Head of HR Operations & Employee Relations
description:
Head of HR Operations & Employee Relations

Join us in building a sustainable society powered by clean energy and reliable connections! As the current role holder is moving on to new challenges, we are looking for a business-oriented Head of HR Operations and Employee Relations to join our HR Leadership Team and help shape Enersenses employee experience through HR operations, services and employment matters.

In this role, you will play a key role in the continuous development of our HR operations, HR services provided to our personnel, payroll and employment-related matters main focus being in Finland. You will lead HR services, the development of HR processes, systems and digitalization, and the payroll team. You will be responsible for developing HR legal practices, guiding the organisation on employment-related matters, and ensuring compliance and continuous dialogue. You will lead a team of seven professionals. Your direct reports will include the Payroll Manager, HR Services Manager, and HR system, process and digitalization specialists.

The position is part of our international Group HR Leadership Team and reports to the EVP, HR, HSEQ, Communications and Sustainability. The preferred work location is our Pasila office in Helsinki, with flexible hybrid working opportunities.

Together with your expert team, you will drive a positive employee experience and smooth HR operations through the following key responsibilities:

Lead HR operations and services
* Lead and develop HRM and employment-related processes
* Drive the development of HR systems and digitalization of the processes
* Lead the HR services function and its continuous improvement

Develop the payroll function and salary payment systems and processes
* Lead the payroll operating model development (mainly external payroll)
* Develop related systems, with a focus on master data and time and attendance systems
* Ensure compliance with legal requirements, such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive
* Lead collaboration with our service providers

Lead HR legal and employment-related matters
* Ensure compliance with employment-related legislation and collective and local agreements
* Develop relations with personnel representatives by continuous dialogue and collaboration
* Develop guidelines and negotiate and implement changes related to employment-related matters
* Support the business and HR colleagues on a wide range of employment-related matters

What do we expect from you?
* A masters degree, preferably in law, and 6-8 years of relevant experience in a business environment. We also welcome candidates with a degree in another field who have extensive experience and expertise in employment matters
* Strong collaboration, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills
* A forward-looking mindset to developing processes and ways of working in a fast-changing and growing international organisation
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution
* Fluency in English and Finnish.

Whats in it for you?Why join Enersense?
* A broad and influential director-level role where you will shape HR operations, services, systems, and employment practices across the organisation
* Genuine ownership of a business-critical HR agenda, with the opportunity to make a visible impact as a member of the Group HR Leadership Team
* The opportunity to lead and develop an experienced team of HR services, payroll, systems, process, and digitalization professionals
* Close collaboration with business leaders, HR colleagues, and external partners on complex and business-critical employment, payroll, and HR operations matters
* A meaningful opportunity to build efficient, compliant, and future-ready HR operations that support our people, our business, and Enersenses contribution to a more sustainable society
* As our company grows it offers you the opportunity to grow with us

Dont meet every requirement?

We know that some candidates apply only when they meet every qualification. If this opportunity excites you but your experience does not fully match all the requirements, we still encourage you to apply.

Are you up for the challenge? Apply for a role where you can develop your skills through meaningful and challenging work in a supportive community.

Please send your application as soon as possible, as we begin interviews during the application period and fill the position once the right candidate is found.

For more information about the position, please contact: Anu Henttonen +358 40 509 3169 Thu 8.10. and Tue 13.10 or by emailanu.henttonen@enersense.com

title: Marine Storekeeper
description:
At Excelerate Energy, we are committed to being the global leader in FSRUs and downstream LNG infrastructure. Our aim is to leverage our unrivaled experience to help customers across the globe unlock access to abundant LNG supply. With the largest fleet in the industry, boasting 11 FSRUs, including a state-of-the-art newbuild expected to be delivered in 2026, we are revolutionizing how the world accesses clean, cost-effective, and reliable energy.

**JOB PURPOSE**

A Marine Store Keeper is an organized, experienced individual who is responsible for all stock management, storage location condition monitoring and improvement.

A storekeeper must be able to multitask and perform under pressure while remaining professional with customers. A Storekeeper is able to manage stock by keeping a record of purchases and ordering the required replacement for spare parts and important items that are required by the different departments on board the Vessel.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES including HSE Requirements:**

1\. The Storekeeper needs ensure that the EE Policies, Procedures and Processes are implemented, enforced and, when applicable, developed, and improved.

2\. Maintain day to day relations with the internal clients (HODs) on Supply Chain related topics.

3\. Review and monitor performance against inventory procedures and strategies to improve performance and effectiveness on the warehouse and inventory location for EE with direct communication to our office staff (Houston HQ)

4\. Provide monthly KPIs including but not limited to:

- Inventory counts

- POs received on board vessels - Inbound Cargo Manifests (MRR)

- Reverse Logistics implementation (Outgoing cargo manifests (MTL) and Manifest for Exportation (MFE)

- New Equipment, Spares, or consumables requests preparation (NSCR) for office generation in the system.


5\. Perform Material Requisitions receptions in a timely manner.

6\. Assist the logistic and procurement dept. to follow up on the OS&D process (Overage, shortage, or Damage).

7\. Keep Chief Engineer fully updated on spare parts and consumable status.

8\. Control and order spare parts and consumables for all Departments (Replenishment Plan)

9\. Follow up, receiving, delivery of spare parts and stores, inspection & storing.

10\. Control, registration and updating data on regular basis in NSE Stock control program.

11\. Maintain current files for Open and Closed Requisitions, Purchase Order, Packing List and Invoices. Over, Short and Damaged OSD, Return to stock.

12\. Daily issues slip form monitoring and proper follow up.

13\. Adequate protection of all parts and tools in storerooms.

14\. Ensures that borrowed tools and instruments are properly returned in good condition and keep tracking report up to date.

15\. Control of and keep storerooms and adjacent compartments clean and tidy, well organized, and spare parts correctly labeled and safely stored.

16\. Maintains good housekeeping practices in all storage areas of the warehouse and outside storage areas

17\. Monitoring all Stores are taken to the Warehouse location in a timely manner after physical reception takes place on board and further distribution to the HOD (Heads of Department) is done of cargo reception.

18\. Maintains good housekeeping of equipment, receiving areas, and storage area following HSE protocols and procedures.

19\. Maintain Filing of Requisition forms, ensuring that they are properly filled up and acknowledged by the requesting parties.

20\. Enter data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records

21\. Implement Cycle counts onto Warehouse shelving and racking structures (Including re organization and material placement inside the location)

22\. Relabeling of materials as required.

23\. Process Implementation for warehouse improvements.

24\. Weekly chemicals and lubes compressed gas bottles, medical supplies, medicines, and personal protective equipment inventory Count.

25\. Transfer orders generation for material transfers within EE Fleet Vessels.

26\. Handover notes preparation for storekeeper relief.

**Crew Matrix Requirements (STCW):**

- Maritime English – CEFR B1

- Cyber Security Awareness

- Bullying and Harassment

- STCW V/1.2.1 Basic training for LNG Tanker Cargo Ops

- STCW VI/1 Basic safety

- STCW VI/6.1 - Security Awareness

- STCW VI/6.2 - Designated security duties


**Technical Competence:**

- MS Office skills with Excel, Power Point, Outlook, and Word.

- Understanding of Warehousing and Inventory management procedures and processes.

- Good Knowledge in Supply chain information systems (ERP).

- Previous Warehousing and Inventory control experience strongly preferred, or ability to demonstrate comparable knowledge and skills. (Preferred 3 years).

- Strong team spirit and customer service orientation.

- Willing to work extended periods of time and perform physical activities


Previous experience on an FSRU vessels is required.

title: Researcher or Doctoral Researcher in justice and sustainability transitions
description:
How can we make the ongoing energy transition more just, and who gets to define what a just transition means? As societies pursue more sustainable energy and industrial systems, questions of justice are becoming increasingly central to public debate and decision-making. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to research addressing these questions in the context of Finlands emerging battery industry. This position requires excellent Finnish language skills and a strong command of English.

LUT University is looking for a researcher or doctoral (junior) researcher to join the Academy Research Fellowship project Circuits of Justice: Exploring Normative and Spatial Dimensions of Justice Across Finlands Battery Supply Chain. The four-year project, led by Dr Alicja Dankowska in LUT Universitys Energy and Society research group, examines how justice claims emerge, circulate, and evolve throughout the Finlands battery supply chain. Taking a whole-systems perspective, the project explores how stakeholders understand, negotiate, and contest different dimensions of justice across places, sectors, and scales.

What your work will be like

As a member of the project team, you will work closely with the principal investigator and contribute to all major stages of the research process. Your work will involve studying policy, media, and public debates on the development of Finlands battery industry through discourse analysis. You will also conduct multi-sited fieldwork, including interviews, focus groups, document analysis, and participant observation.

You will help desing and facilitate stakeholder co-creation workshops that explore pathways towards a more just transition and take part in analysing and interpreting research data with the project team. You will also contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, and other dissemination activities and participate in international research collaboration, including research visits to Norway and Spain.

What we expect

We are looking for an independent, proactive, and collaborative researcher who enjoys working with colleagues, stakeholders, and international research partners.

Applicants for the researcher position must have a relevant doctoral degree and advanced research experience. Applicants for the doctoral (junior) researcher position must hold a relevant masters degree.

You should have a background in a relevant social science discipline, such as sociology, political science, human geography, anthropology, sustainability studies, environmental policy, or a related field. You also need to have experience in discourse analysis – particularly policy or media analysis – as well as strong qualitative research skills and interest in fieldwork.

Knowledge of energy transitions, sustainability transitions, science and technology studies (STS), or just transitions and energy justice is highly desirable. Experience related to batteries, critical raw materials, mining, energy systems, or industrial transitions is considered an advantage.

What we offer

This position offers an opportunity to contribute to a novel and societally relevant research project in close collaboration with national and international research partners. You will be able to develop your qualitative and interdisciplinary research expertise while receiving support for scientific publishing and conference participation. The project also provides opportunities for international research mobility and a collegial, supportive research environment within LUT Universitys Energy and Society research group.

We will fill the position at either of the following levels:

Doctoral (junior) researcher

- The position is full-time. It begins with a one-year term (including a six-month trial period) and may be extended by three years, depending on the progress of your studies and the quality of your research.

- The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

- The selected candidate must apply for the right to pursue doctoral studies at the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of employment.

Researcher

- The employment relationship is part-time (70% of full-time) with a fixed term running until 31 August 2030 (including a six-month trial period).

- The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement levels 5–6). The starting salary is approximately EUR 4,300–5,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience and based on the part-time workload.

The work starts as soon as possible, and the start date is negotiable. The position is based at LUTs Lappeenranta campus in Finland. title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
description:
Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!

In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.

In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that:
Every moment is pedagogical
Play is the foundation of learning
Learning happens throughout the whole day
Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround
Childrens interests and questions guide learning

Your core responsibilities:
Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities
Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses
Observe and document childrens learning and development
Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families
Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals
Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoors

Our daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.

We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.

Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027:
Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship
At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education
At least level B2 in English language
Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly.

Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028:
Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language
Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland
Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre
Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis

We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.

We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible:
Assistance with degree recognition process
Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment
Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland
Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members)
Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.

Language training and relocation schedule:
Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential.
Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.

Salary and benefits:
Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience
ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting)
Comprehensive private occupational health care
Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers
Holiday bonus pay

Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process:
Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc
Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY
Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4

We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!

Please note:
(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.
(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

title: Logistiikkatyöntekijä / Logistikarbetare
description:
ETSIMME LOGISTIIKKATYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ VUOROTYÖHÖN

Haemme motivoituneita ja ammattitaitoisia logistiikkatyöntekijöitä osaksi logistiikkatiimiämme. Tehtäviä on tarjolla sekä sisäisessä että ulkoisessa logistiikassa. Logistiikkatyöntekijänä vastaat monipuolisista materiaalivirtoihin, varastointiin ja toimituksiin liittyvistä tehtävistä, kuten:

* työkalusarjojen ja muiden materiaalien toimittaminen tuotantolinjoille

* valmiiden tuotteiden vastaanottaminen tuotannosta

* saapuvien ja lähtevien tavaroiden vastaanotto, käsittely ja lähetys

* vastaanotettujen määrien kirjaaminen ERP-järjestelmään ja varastosaldojen ylläpito

* varastoalueiden järjestyksestä, turvallisuudesta ja tehokkaasta käytöstä huolehtiminen

Työ on vuorotyötä. Käytössä olevat vuoromallit ovat tällä hetkellä 2-, 3- ja 5-vuorotyö (TAM25, TAM35 ja TAM37). Työvuoromalli määräytyy tehtävän ja työskentelykohteen mukaan.

KETÄ ETSIMME?

Etsimme oma-aloitteisia ja palveluhenkisiä tekijöitä, joilla on reipas asenne työntekoon. Sinua motivoi mahdollisuus vaikuttaa työn sujuvuuteen ja lopputuloksen laatuun. Turvallisuus ja laatu ovat sinulle tinkimättömiä periaatteita. Teet mielelläsi yhteistyötä muiden trukinkuljettajien, operaattoreiden ja esihenkilöiden kanssa, ja hahmotat kokonaisuuksia ratkaistaksesi arjessa vastaan tulevia tilanteita yhdessä muiden kanssa. Olet myös valmis kehittämään osaamistasi tulevaisuudessa.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

* Tehtävään soveltuva ammatillinen peruskoulutus tai aiempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä

* Pystyt kommunikoimaan sujuvasti suomeksi tai ruotsiksi, kaksikielisyys ja hyvä englannin kielen taito lasketaan eduksi

* Hyvät tietotekniset valmiudet

* Trukkikokemus katsotaan eduksi, mutta koulutamme tarvittaessa

* Työturvallisuuskortti katsotaan eduksi, mutta koulutamme tarvittaessa

Työhön valituille henkilöille tehdään päihdeohjelmamme mukainen huumausainetesti.

Lisätietoja tehtävistä antavat Kaj Nygård (+358 50 598 3090) ja Martin Pettersson (+358 50 343 5303).


VI SÖKER LOGISTIKMEDARBETARE FÖR SKIFTARBETE

Vi söker motiverade och yrkeskunniga logistikmedarbetare till vårt logistikteam. Det finns arbetsuppgifter inom både intern och extern logistik. Som logistikmedarbetare ansvarar du för mångsidiga uppgifter inom materialflöden, lagerhållning och leveranser, såsom:

* leverans av verktygssatser och annat material till produktionslinjerna

* mottagning av färdiga produkter från produktionen

* mottagning, hantering och avsändning av inkommande och utgående varor

* registrering av mottagna mängder i ERP-systemet och uppdatering av lagersaldon

* upprätthållande av ordning och säkerhet på lagerområdena samt ett effektivt utnyttjande av dem

Arbetet är skiftarbete. De skiftmodeller som för närvarande används är 2-, 3- och 5-skiftsarbete (TAM25, TAM35 och TAM37). Skiftmodellen bestäms enligt arbetsuppgift och arbetsställe.

VEM SÖKER VI?

Vi söker initiativrika och serviceinriktade personer med en positiv inställning till arbetet. Du motiveras av möjligheten att påverka hur smidigt arbetet löper och kvaliteten på slutresultatet. Säkerhet och kvalitet är kompromisslösa principer för dig. Du samarbetar gärna med andra truckförare, operatörer och chefer, och du kan se helheten för att tillsammans med andra lösa situationer som uppstår i vardagen. Du är också beredd att utveckla din kompetens i framtiden.

VAD FÖRVÄNTAR VI OSS AV DIG?

* lämplig yrkesinriktad grundutbildning eller tidigare erfarenhet av motsvarande uppgifter

* du kan kommunicera obehindrat på finska eller svenska; tvåspråkighet och goda kunskaper i engelska ses som en fördel

* goda IT-färdigheter

* Erfarenhet av truckkörning ses som en fördel, men vi utbildar vid behov.

* Arbetssäkerhetskort ses som en fördel, men vi utbildar vid behov.

De personer som väljs för arbetet genomgår ett drogtest i enlighet med vårt rusmedelsprogram.

Mer information om arbetsuppgifterna ges av Kaj Nygård (+358 50 598 3090) och Martin Pettersson (+358 50 343 5303).


WE ARE LOOKING FOR LOGISTICS EMPLOYEES FOR SHIFT WORK

We are looking for motivated and skilled logistics employees to join our logistics team. Positions are available in both internal and external logistics. As a logistics employee, you will be responsible for a variety of tasks related to material flows, warehousing and deliveries, including:

* delivering tool sets and other materials to production lines

* receiving finished products from production

* receiving, handling and dispatching incoming and outgoing goods

* recording received quantities in the ERP system and maintaining inventory balances

* maintaining order and safety in warehouse areas and ensuring their efficient use

The work is carried out in shifts. The shift models currently in use are 2-shift, 3-shift and 5-shift work (TAM25, TAM35 and TAM37). The applicable shift model depends on the role and work location.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for proactive and service-minded people with a positive attitude towards work. You are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to smooth operations and the quality of the end result. Safety and quality are non-negotiable principles for you. You enjoy working with other forklift drivers, operators and supervisors, and you can see the bigger picture when solving everyday situations together with others. You are also willing to develop your skills in the future.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

* a suitable vocational qualification or previous experience in similar duties

* the ability to communicate fluently in Finnish or Swedish; bilingual skills and a good command of English are considered an advantage

* good IT skills

* Forklift driving experience is considered an advantage, but training will be provided if needed.

* An occupational safety card is considered an advantage, but training will be provided if needed.

Successful candidates will be required to undergo a drug test in accordance with our substance abuse programme.

For more information about the positions, please contact Kaj Nygård (+358 50 598 3090) or Martin Pettersson (+358 50 343 5303).

title: Service Instructor
description:

People enjoy working at N-Clean, and our employee eNPS score is an outstanding 55! This is reflected in our daily work through mutual respect and a genuine commitment to succeeding together.

N-Clean has succeeded in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-oriented and responsible working life. In 2024, we were chosen as the Most Human-Centric Workplace in Finland, and in 2025 we placed third in the competition and achieved 3rd place in the Finlands Most Human-Centric Working Life Act category. This recognition highlights our people-focused recruitment approach, where meaningful encounters, appreciation, and candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

**Join our top team!**

We only accept applications submitted through the application form on our website.

title: Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Kalajoelle
description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Etsimme helpperiä avustamaan senioriasiakastamme kolmesti viikossa 1,5h ajan. Käynneillä seurustelua ja kodin askareissa avustamista.

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,98-15,40 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

title: Traineeship posts at ECHA (March 2027)
description:
**Traineeship Posts at ECHA**

**Please note that the European Chemicals Agency and the job position are located in Helsinki, Finland.**

ECHA is looking for newly-qualified graduates who are willing to make a contribution to the everyday work of the Agency.

There are up to 20 graduate traineeship opportunities per year in scientific fields such as chemistry, toxicology, biology, environmental science and technologies, and administrative duties such as law, communications, finance, human resources and ICT. The traineeships usually start in the beginning of March or September.

**The trainee scheme is designed for:**

· Recent university graduates and holders of a technical or professional qualification of an equivalent level in fields relevant to applicable chemicals legislation or other fields relevant to the administration tasks of an EU institution;

· Public or private sector employees engaged in graduate-level work in fields relevant to applicable chemicals legislation.

**Duration**

Traineeships last six months and may not be extended beyond this period.

**Grants**

The graduate trainee scheme offers a grant of approximately 1,704 euro.

Trainees who continue to receive remuneration from their employer, or any other grant or allowance will only be entitled to a grant from ECHA if the amount they receive is less than the one indicated above. In this case, trainees will receive an amount equal to the difference between their income and the level of ECHA's grant.

Trainees in employment must provide a declaration of remuneration, expenses and allowances signed by their employer.

**Eligibility Criteria**

To apply for a graduate traineeship you must:

· Be a national of a Member State of the EU or a national of the European Economic Area (Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein)

· Be able to communicate in English as this is the working language of ECHA

· Have obtained a university degree or equivalent or engaged in graduate-level work in fields relevant ECHA

You will be invited for a remote interview if you are selected.

Trainees do not benefit from sickness insurance. Before the start of your traineeship you must prove you are covered by a sickness and accident insurance valid in Finland.

Traineeships are not offered to applicants who have already been a trainee in a European institution or body, employed by a European institution or body, or worked for ECHA as an interim staff member, researcher or in house expert for more than eight weeks.

Applicants can only apply to a maximum of 3 (three) traineeship positions per cycle.

Open traineeship posts: Careers

The deadline to fill in the application form is **2 November 2026** at noon 12:00 Helsinki time (11:00 a.m. CET).

title: Mechanical Engineer, CHEC CAM Project
description:
China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd. (CHEC) is a world-renowned international contractor and a leading provider of comprehensive services across the entire industry chain for both public and private sectors. CHEC has been engaged as the main contractor for the CAM Plant project in Kotka, responsible for the implementation and construction of the plant.

We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer (Automated Warehouse Installation and Commissioning) to join the CHEC team for the Kotka CAM Plant project to support the project during the construction, installation, testing, statutory inspection, commissioning and handover stages.

The job

In this role youre responsible for reviewing technical proposals, coordinating site installation, managing installation subcontractors, and supporting the commissioning and handover of automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS) and associated mechanical equipment.

Key Responsibilities

- Review installation drawings, method statements, lifting plans and commissioning procedures, and follow up on review comments.
- Coordinate the installation of warehouse racking, stacker cranes, conveyors and associated equipment, including work sequencing, resources and site readiness.
- Manage installation subcontractors, monitoring progress, workmanship, staffing and compliance with site safety requirements.
- Coordinate technical interfaces with equipment suppliers, designers and civil, electrical, automation and fire protection teams.
- Organize equipment delivery inspections, installation checks and milestone inspections, and review quality records.
- Participate in equipment commissioning, integrated system testing and trial operation; support troubleshooting and track corrective actions.
- Support performance testing, final acceptance, punch-list closure and handover documentation.

Required Experience and Competence

- Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline.
- At least five years of experience in industrial mechanical equipment installation.
- Hands-on installation and commissioning experience on automated warehouse or AS/RS projects.
- Sound knowledge of AS/RS equipment, installation methods and quality control requirements.
- Ability to independently review technical drawings and installation method statements.
- Proven experience in site coordination and installation subcontractor management.
- Experience in mechanical troubleshooting, commissioning and acceptance testing, with an understanding of electrical and automation interfaces.
- Working proficiency in English for technical documentation, correspondence and site coordination.
- Willingness to work at the project site in Finland.

This project offers a fantastic opportunity to contribute to a high-impact initiative and develop professionally in a diverse and challenging environment.

Preferred start date: According to an agreement as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process or the role, please contact Barona Engineering Senior Consultant Katri Hyppänen at +358 50 439 9785. Available on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays from 10 am to 2 pm.

We will be interviewing applicants during the application period, so please apply through the provided link. Kindly attach your English-language CV to the application. For privacy reasons, we do not accept applications via email or WhatsApp.

title: Aamupalatarjoilija / huonesiivooja
description:
Haluatko yhdistää tasokkaan asiakaspalvelun, puhtaat aamiaismaut, tarkan siivousjäljen ja Suomen kauneimman luonnon? Polku Hotelli on ainutlaatuinen luontohotelli Nuuksion kansallispuiston sydämessä. Etsimme nyt tiimiimme vahvistukseksi **monitaitoista aamupalatarjoilijaa / huonesiivoojaa**, joka haluaa luoda vieraillemme unohtumattomia ja siistejä hotellielämyksiä kansallispuiston rauhassa.

Työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia ja ne on jaettu selkeästi kahteen osaan:

- **Klo 6.30–10.00 aamupalavuoro:** Vastaat aamiaisen valmistelusta (kuten puuron keitosta ja piirakoiden paistosta), aamupalan esillelaitosta sekä vieraidemme ystävällisestä palvelusta aamiaisella.

- **Aamupalan jälkeen huonesiivous:** Huolehdit hotellihuoneidemme puhtaudesta ja viihtyisyydestä teemalla lakanoiden vaihto, imurointi sekä muut perushuonesiivoustehtävät.


Meillä pääset osaksi lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa puhallamme aina yhteen hiileen.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

- **Aiempaa kokemusta ja osaamista:** Sinulla on jo aiempaa kokemusta ravintola-alan töistä, mikä on edellytys tehtävässä menestymiselle. Kokemus siivoustyöstä katsotaan suureksi plussaksi. Alan koulutus on eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on reipas ja ammattitaitoinen ote työhön.

- **Aamuvirkkua ja tarkkaa asennetta:** Viihdyt aikaisissa aamuvuoroissa ja sinulla on silmää puhtaudelle sekä järjestykselle. Haluat, että hotellihuoneet hohtavat puhtauttaan asiakkaiden saapuessa.

- **Kielitaitoa:** Kommunikoit sujuvasti sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Kaikki muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksesi.

- **Kulkuyhteydet:** Koska hotelli sijaitsee keskellä luonnonrauhaa kansallispuistossa, tarvitset työssäsi omaa autoa – perille ei pääse julkisilla kulkuneuvoilla. Aamuvuorot alkavat klo 6.30.


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Uniikin ja inspiroivan työympäristön Kurjolammen rannalla, keskellä koskematonta luontoa.

- Säännöllisen ja monipuolisen päivätyön, jossa pääset tekemään sekä asiakaspalvelua että itsenäistä suorittavaa työtä.

- Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tiimin jatkuvan tuen.

- Palkkaus ja työehdot perustuvat MaRaVan työehtosopimukseen.


**Yrityksestä**

Polku Hotelli on moderni ja viihtyisä huoneistohotelli, jossa yhdistyvät korkealaatuinen majoitus, kokouspalvelut, luonnon puhtaat maut ja ainutlaatuiset elämykset. Polku Hotellissa arjen kiireet unohtuvat ja akut latautuvat niin asiakkailla kuin työntekijöillä.

**Heräsikö kysymyksiä?**

Laita meille sähköpostia **rekry@jobtodo.fi**, vastaamme kaikkiin kysymyksiisi. Viestimme enimmäkseen sähköpostilla, joten tarkkaile sähköpostiasi. Pidäthän varmuuden vuoksi silmällä myös roskapostikansiotasi.

Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.

title: Finance & Insurance Coordinator JLR Finland
description:

Join **Inchcape JLR Finland**, part of Inchcape's global network.

You'll play a key role in delivering great experiences for our customers and partners while helping to drive the growth of Jaguar Land Rover's Finance & Insurance business across Finland.

In this position, you will support the execution of the F&I strategy by working closely with retailers, finance and insurance partners, and internal stakeholders to improve commercial performance, customer retention, and profitability.

**What you'll do**

**Finance & Insurance Strategy & Performance**

- Support the execution of JLR Finland's F&I strategy and turn commercial priorities into actions across the retailer network

**Product, Process & Programme Implementation**

- A proactive, self-driven, and solution-oriented attitude.

- Ability to translate data and insights into business actions.

- Fluency in Finnish and English.

- Experience within automotive finance, leasing, insurance products, or dealer networks is considered an advantage.


In this role, success means delivering measurable improvements in finance and insurance performance across the retailer network. You'll help increase financed vehicle volumes, customer renewals, and F&I profitability, while ensuring retailers, finance partners, and insurance providers work together effectively to achieve shared commercial objectives.

**Start your journey**

If youre excited about this role but dont meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this role or another opportunity within Inchcape. Join our team and become part of a leading global automotive company that is transforming tomorrow, together.

At Inchcape, were shaping the future of mobility, and youre invited to shape it with us. Youll join a collaborative culture that values wellbeing, growth, and inclusion. Through impactful work, ongoing development, and global and local rewards, we create a workplace for people to succeed and fulfil your aspirations.

**Opportunity for everyone**

Inchcape actively encourages applicants from all identities, backgrounds, and experiences, helping ensure our workforce is representative of the global communities we operate in. Read more here about our Inclusion and Diversity commitments, including our targets, programmes, and policies.
