title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, 7mo fixed term ,
description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a fixed term position with good possibility to continue further in the island of Föglö, Åland.

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5h/weekk
- Salary: approx. 12,50-14,00 EUR/h in the beginning, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: 20-37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 12,50-14,00eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Haethan työpaikkaa pian: paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We have a strong and growing product development organization made up of experienced professionals and talented junior engineers. Our product roadmap is healthy well into the future, offering a variety of technically meaningful challenges.

To support our long-term roadmap and ambitious technology goals, we are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to help develop and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and processes that enable efficient, secure, and high-quality software and product delivery.

We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in DevOps toolchains, automation, CI/CD, and Kubernetes-based platforms.

**Your** **role**

As a **DevOps Engineer**, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the development infrastructure used throughout the product lifecycle, including the underlying network connectivity and security controls. The environment includes source code and artifact management, build and release automation, test infrastructure, Kubernetes-based platforms, and integrations supporting requirements management, verification, validation, and product releases.

You will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline development workflows and introduce modern tools and practices that support developers in their daily work.

**Main Responsibilities**

- Maintain and continuously improve the development environment and DevOps toolchain, manage source code repositories, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact repositories.

- Design, implement, and maintain secure, resilient network connectivity for development, build, test and deployment environments and troubleshoot issues.

- Support network architecture and configuration for Kubernetes-based platforms, including ingress controls, load balancing, DNS, service connectivity, network policies and certificate management.

- Ensure development infrastructure complies with relevant standards, cybersecurity requirements, and regulations.

- Automate manual processes and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, reliability, traceability, and quality.

- Integrate security controls, vulnerability management, and compliance checks into the software development lifecycle.

- Evaluate, implement, and support AI-powered tools that enhance developer productivity.

- Administer developer tools and software, integrate development data sources to provide clear visibility and reporting across the product development lifecycle.


**Your profile**

Our ideal candidate has a strong background in DevOps, automation, and software development tooling.

You are a proactive, hands-on professional who can apply industry best practices to modern, highly secure and regulated engineering environments.

**Required Skills**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.

- Minimum five years of relevant experience in DevOps, Build Engineering, Software Tooling, or a similar role.

- Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, load balancing, TLS/PKI, and network segmentation.

- Experience with DevOps technologies such as GitLab, Git, Docker, Jenkins, Artifactory, Nexus, or similar.

- Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery processes.

- Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes-based container platforms.

- Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure software development, open-source software governance, and DevSecOps practices.

- Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.

- Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar).

- Strong communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.


We do not expect you to meet every requirement listed above. If you have a strong DevOps background, a hands-on mindset, and experience in many of the areas described, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges just as much as experience with specific tools.

**What you will be part of**

Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of Saab Surveillance business area. Our R&D teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: **to keep people safe**. As an example of a brilliant product we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact!

We support flexible ways of working and offer opportunities for occasional remote work when the nature of the tasks allows. As a DevOps Engineer, you will work closely with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to continuously improve our development platforms, tools, and processes. Because of this close collaboration and the nature of our development environment, most work is carried out on-site at our modern Saab Technology Center in Tampere.

On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options.

In this job, some of your tasks have a connection to defense secrecy. Therefore, a drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance act 726/2014 is required for the selected applicant.

**Why join us?**

- Play a key role in enabling the development of cutting-edge electronic warfare systems

- Work with modern DevOps technologies, Kubernetes platforms, and automation solutions

- Take ownership of processes and solutions that directly support product development and delivery

- Collaborate with highly skilled software, systems, and engineering professionals

- Grow your expertise through continuous learning, training opportunities, and challenging technical projects


We are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides.

**Interested?**

Take your chance to build your future career at Saab by submitting your CV and application via Saab Careers already now!

title: Sourcing Engineer – Electronics and RF Categories
description:
**Your role**

As a **Sourcing Engineer**, you will play a key role in securing the supply of technically demanding electronic components and modules used in advanced electronic warfare systems. In this role, you will work closely with engineering teams and global suppliers to ensure access to cutting-edge technologies in a fast-evolving and strategically important environment.

You will be responsible for sourcing within advanced electronics categories. Previous experience in the relevant categories is beneficial; however, we also welcome sourcing professionals with experience in other complex technical categories and an interest in developing their expertise further.

As part of the Sourcing and Production team, you will manage relationships with current and potential suppliers and work closely with stakeholders across engineering, projects, production, quality and supply chain. Your work will help ensure an efficient, resilient and uninterrupted supply chain that meets project and production needs. The role includes occasional domestic and international travel to supplier sites, Saab locations and industry events, typically accounting for approximately 10-20% of working time.

The role operates in a challenging and complex environment, where Saab continuously pushes the boundaries of what is technically possible. Success in this role requires strong communication and planning skills, a commercial and analytical mindset, and a proactive approach to supplier management.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Take commercial responsibility for assigned sourcing categories supporting projects and production throughout the product lifecycle.

- Continuously assess the competitiveness, capability, capacity and risk profile of the supplier portfolio.

- Develop and maintain long-term supplier relationships, in close co-operation with internal stakeholders.

- Lead sourcing activities, including RFQs, quotation evaluation, commercial negotiations and supplier agreement management.

- Monitor market trends, component availability, lead times, pricing and obsolescence risks within the assigned categories.

- Identify and drive opportunities for cost efficiency, supplier development and supply-chain resilience.

- Ensure compliance with Saabs sourcing strategy, policies, procedures and applicable requirements.


Your profile

To thrive in this role, you are commercially minded, structured and customer-oriented. You communicate confidently with different stakeholders and are comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a cross-functional team.

You have an analytical approach and the ability to manage several priorities in a fast-paced and technically demanding environment. You are proactive in engaging with suppliers and able to take initiative when identifying supply-chain risks, commercial opportunities or improvement needs.

**Required skills**

- University degree in Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain Management or a related field; alternatively, equivalent relevant work experience

- Experience in strategic sourcing, procurement or supplier management

- Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills

- Excellent written and spoken Finnish and English

- Experience in analysing sourcing, supplier or commercial data using Excel or similar tools


**We also appreciate**

- Experience of sourcing technically demanding electronic components, modules or related products, such as FPGAs, RF components, RF modules or GNSS/INS modules

- Understanding of the electronics-component market, including availability challenges, long lead times, lifecycle management and obsolescence

- Experience of working with ERP systems, for example IFS

- Experience in utilizing AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, data analysis or sourcing processes

- Experience in the electronics, high-technology, aerospace or defence industry

- Technical understanding of electronics, RF technologies or embedded systems


We do not expect you to meet every preferred qualification listed above. If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply!

**What you will be part of**

Saab is one of the world's leading defence and security companies, specializing in air, land, and naval defence, civil security, and commercial aerospace. Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of business area Surveillance. Our teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: **to keep people and society safe**. As an example of a brilliant product that we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact!

In addition to extremely interesting projects, we offer you unique career opportunities where on-going training and development is also provided to help you build your career. We are big enough to offer a wide range of opportunities, but agile enough to be noticed and recognized.

We value work-life balance and offer flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely 2-3 days per week when business needs allow. To support a successful onboarding and help you build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, we expect a higher on-site presence during the first months in the role. After that, the position offers a flexible hybrid working model.

On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options.

Please note that some of the tasks in this position are connected to defence secrecy. A drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance Act (726/2014) are required for the selected applicant.

We hope to welcome you to the team in January 2027 or as soon as possible. We understand that candidates have different notice periods and circumstances, so we are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides.

**Interested?**

Please send your CV and application with the salary request through the Saab Career System, **latest by 25th October 2026**.

title: Ravintolan kokki, Hämeen Valtatieravintolat Oy, Hotel Fabrik & Ravintola Villa, Forssa

title: Chef - Bliss Bar and Grill
description:
COOK – BLISS BAR & GRILL, JÄTKÄSAARI

A new **Bliss Bar & Grill** will open in Jätkäsaari, Helsinki, in November, and we are now looking for skilled and motivated **cooks** to join our new team.

We offer both **full-time and part-time positions**, with flexible start dates during November.

- preparing lunch and à la carte dishes

- food preparation and daily kitchen tasks

- ensuring food quality, hygiene and compliance with self-monitoring procedures

- taking special dietary requirements into account

- working closely with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house team


Depending on your skills and experience, the role may also include contributing to menu planning and the development of kitchen operations.

- previous experience in a restaurant kitchen and/or relevant education

- the ability to work independently and as part of a team

- a careful, efficient and responsible approach to work

- a good understanding of food hygiene and special dietary requirements

- a valid Hygiene Passport

- willingness to work evenings and weekends

- sufficient Finnish and/or English skills to perform the duties


Experience in an **à la carte kitchen and/or lunch service** is considered an advantage, as is an interest in contributing to menu and operational development.

What can you expect from us?

You will join a brand-new restaurant team from the very beginning. The work is varied and includes both lunch and à la carte service.

We want to build a workplace where good teamwork, a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality work go hand in hand. We value initiative and responsibility and offer you the opportunity to contribute to how the new restaurant operates and develops.

Both **full-time and part-time positions** are available.

How to apply

Please send us a short application and your CV. In your application, tell us:

- whether you are looking for full-time or part-time work

- when you would be available to start

- briefly about your previous experience in restaurant kitchens


**Workplace:** Bliss Bar & Grill, Jätkäsaari, Helsinki

**Start date:** flexible during November

**Come build something new with us. Welcome to Bliss!**

You will join a brand-new restaurant team from the very beginning. The work is varied and includes both lunch and à la carte service.

title: Siivoojia tehdassiivoukseen Nokialle
description:
Etsimme aurinkoiseen joukkoomme vähintään kuutta huolellista ja luotettavaa

PALVELUVASTAAVAA TEOLLISUUSKOHTEEN SIIVOUSTEHTÄVIIN NOKIALLE

vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tarjolla on sekä osa-aikaisia että kokoaikaisia työsuhteita.



Työt alkavat 29.12.2026.

Monipuolinen ja vastuullinen työnkuva

Tehtävässäsi palveluvastaavana huolehdit siisteydestä ja puhtaudesta monipuolisessa teollisuuskohteessa Nokialla. Työpäiväsi ovat vaihtelevia ja pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan työympäristön viihtyvyyteen ja turvallisuuteen. Teollisuuden tuotantotiloissa työskenneltäessä on tärkeää ottaa huomioon ympäristön erityispiirteet. Tuotantotiloissa työolosuhteet voivat olla ajoittain lämpimät ja tiloissa voi esiintyä tuotantoprosessista aiheutuvia hajuja. Turvallisuus on kohteessa kaiken keskiössä: tuotannon tiloissa on paljon liikennettä, kuten trukkeja ja AGV-vaunuja, joten tarkkaavaisuus ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattaminen on välttämätöntä. Teet työtä itsenäisesti, mutta kuulut isoon tiimiin ja kohtaat päivittäin lukuisia asiakkaan edustajia, joten asiakaspalveluasenne on avainasemassa.

Työtehtäviisi sisältyvät:

- Sosiaali- ja taukotilojen siivous.

- Toimistojen, neuvottelutilojen ja aulojen sekä muiden yleisten tilojen siivous.

- Tuotantotilojen siivous sopimuksen mukaan ja turvallisesti.

- Varmistat osana työyhteisöä, että tilat ovat turvalliset ja esteettömät.

- Vahinkojen ja huoltotarpeiden raportointi ohjeistuksen mukaisesti.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat kello 6–20 välille maanantaista lauantaihin työvuorolistan mukaisesti. Työtunteja kertyy tehtävästä riippuen 15–37,5 tuntia viikossa. Tarjolla on sekä osa-aikaisia että kokoaikaisia työsuhteita, joten kerrothan hakulomakkeella kummasta vaihtoehdosta olet kiinnostunut. Koska työajat vaihtelevat aamu- ja iltavuorojen välillä, toivomme sinulta joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen sekä valmiutta työskennellä aikaisissa aamuissa ja myöhäisissä illoissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Aiempaa työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä.

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Kohteessa toimii suuri tiimi ja asiakkaan edustajia, joten sujuva kommunikaatio on tärkeää.

- Joustavuutta työajoissa aamu- ja iltavuorojen välillä.

- Täysi-ikäisyyttä.

- Suomen kielen taitoa (taso B1-B2). Turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi sinun tulee kyetä kommunikoimaan suomeksi ja ymmärtämään suomenkieliset työ- ja turvallisuusohjeet täysin.
[Good Proficiency in Finnish (B1-B2 level) is required. Due to safety requirements, you must be able to communicate in Finnish and fully understand work-related and safety instructions provided in Finnish.]

Eduksi katsomme:

- Eritoten kokemus teollisuuden puhtauspalveluiden tuottamisesta katsotaan eduksi.

- Voimassa olevan työturvallisuuskortin.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

- Merkityksellisen työn.

- Mukavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä esimiehen ja tiimin tuen.

- Laadukkaat ja toimivat työvälineet.

- Koeajan jälkeen lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyden palvelut sekä liikunta- ja hierontaedut käyttöösi.

- SOL Life -ohjelman mukaisen panostuksen työturvallisuuteesi ja hyvinvointiisi.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja edetä urallasi. Tarjoamme koulutuksia ja erilaisia urapolkuja.

Palkkaus noudattaa kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta palkkaryhmässä 2-3.



Kiinnostuitko? Haethan paikkaa mahdollisimman pian täyttämällä sähköisen hakemuslomakkeemme huolella ja liittämällä mukaan ansioluettelosi ja/tai hakukirjeesi. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Miia Mustalahti, miia.mustalahti(at)sol.fi. Huomaathan, että otamme hakemukset vastaan ainoastaan sähköisen hakujärjestelmämme kautta.

Me SOLissa käytämme siivoustyön ammattilaisistamme nimitystä palveluvastaava, sillä he ovat vastuussa tuottamastaan palvelusta eli erinomaisesta siivousjäljestä ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä. Jos etsit työtä mukavassa työporukassa ja jossa pääset näkemään kätesi jäljen, hae meille nyt!

Liity osaksi aurinkoista porukkaamme!




Tarjoamme


- Liikunta- ja hierontaetu

- Lakisääteistä laajempi työterveyshuolto

- Työsuhde-edut voimassa koeajan jälkeen.



SOL Palvelut Oy

Meille on tärkeää työssä viihtyminen ja kannustava ilmapiiri – toimintaamme ohjaavat SOL arvot: aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas, arkiluovuus, yrittäjyys, luotettavuus ja iloinen työn tekeminen.
Jos nämä arvot resonoivat kanssasi, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!
Arvostamiamme ominaisuuksia ovat myös oma-aloitteisuus, vastuullisuus ja täsmällisyys.



SOL on osaava, monipuolinen ja kansainvälisesti toimiva suomalainen palvelualan perheyritys, jonka keskiössä on aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas ja iloinen työn tekeminen.

SOL Palvelut Oy:n palveluihin kuuluu siivous- ja toimitilapalvelut. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme puhtauden ja korkean hygienian ratkaisuja, joilla vaikutamme työympäristöjen viihtyvyyteen ja turvallisuuteen.

SOL Palvelut Oy on osa SOL-konsernia, joka työllistää noin 13 000 aurinkoista SOLilaista.



SOL KONSERNI

Iloisiin SOLilaisiin kuuluu [turvallisuusalan, kiinteistönhuollon, talotekniikan, puhtaanapidon ja tekstiilihuollon ammattilaisia](https://www.sol.fi/). Lisäksi tarjoamme [henkilöstövuokrauspalveluja](https://www.sol.fi/palvelut/henkilostopalvelut/) joustavasti eri toimialoille.

Arvostamme osaamista ja ammattitaitoa. Vahva osaaminen taataan räätälöidyillä perehdytyksillä, sisäisillä koulutuksilla sekä oppilaitosyhteistyöllä. Myös eteneminen on mahdollista erilaisten urapolkujen avulla. Työssäsi sinua kannustaa ja tukee oma esihenkilösi sekä koko tiimi.

SOL Life-ohjelman avulla kehitämme työhyvinvointia sekä panostamme työntekijöidemme työturvallisuuteen.

Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössä. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri ikäisiä ja eri sukupuolia olevia henkilöitä sekä kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä.

[Lue lisää toimintamme vastuullisuudesta ja tarinastamme.](https://www.sol.fi/vastuullisuus/)

[Ohjeet turvalliseen työhön](https://www.esitteemme.fi/SOL/MailView/)
[Guidelines for safe work](https://www.esitteemme.fi/SOL_Kiinteistopalvelut_Oy_ENG/MailView/)

title: Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner
description:
We are looking for a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner to shape St1's CRM approach and deliver the Salesforce-based solutions that support our sales, customer service, and business operations. This role sits where business needs meet technical delivery: you make sure what we build is scalable, secure, and actually adopted by the people who use it.

A big part of the role is partnering with business teams who are actively developing their digital ways of working. You act as a trusted advisor, drawing on experience from multiple Salesforce implementations to guide teams, introduce best practices, and drive real process change and adoption, not just deliver features.

You work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and administrators, translating requirements into a prioritized backlog and actionable solutions. This is a hands-on role: it combines business analysis with real configuration work in Salesforce, so you are as comfortable writing a user story as you are building in the platform.

How youll help drive the change

Joining St1, youll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner, youll play a key role in

Product Strategy & Vision

Define and communicate the roadmap for Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud capabilities.

Align platform initiatives with business objectives and customer experience goals.

Continuously evaluate new Salesforce features and innovations for business value.

Backlog & Requirements Management

Own and maintain the Sales & Service product backlog.

Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements.

Translate business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep backlog items well-defined and ready for development.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance on Salesforce architecture, integrations, and configurations.

Partner with architects and developers to design scalable, secure solutions, and review designs against best practices and enterprise standards.

Configure Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud hands-on where needed.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Act as the primary liaison between business users, Business Technology, and external vendor teams.

Design and facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and process improvements that help business teams build confidence and capability.

Manage expectations and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.

Partner with business leads to drive user adoption: coaching teams through change, addressing resistance, and building long-term ownership of new ways of working.

Share insights and best practices from prior implementations to help the business make informed decisions and avoid common pitfalls.

Platform Governance & Quality

Ensure compliance with security, data, and governance standards.

Promote best practices for development, documentation, and deployment.

What you bring to the team

Were looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have:

5+ years of experience working with Salesforce platforms, including 3+ years in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, or Technical Lead role.

Proven hands-on experience configuring Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud.

Strong understanding of CRM, sales operations, and customer service processes.

Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and process adoption in environments with varying levels of digital maturity.

Track record of delivering Salesforce implementations across multiple organizations, with the ability to bring cross-industry best practices to new contexts.

A bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Knowledge of Finnish or Swedish as a native speaker, and fluent written and spoken knowledge of English. Other Nordic languages are a plus.

Nice to have: Salesforce certifications (e.g. Administrator, Platform Developer, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant), experience with Einstein or Agentforce, and experience in large-scale, highly integrated environments.

Who are we looking for

We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. We value people who are curious, commercial, committed and caring, and who thrive in collaborative, fast-changing environments.

Why Join St1?

- Shape St1s CRM vision and create tangible impact across sales and customer service.
- Blend business insight with hands-on design and delivery.
- Influence how teams adopt modern digital ways of working.
- Develop into Salesforce architecture, AI-powered CRM, or product leadership.
- Helsinki or Stockholm base, with excellent social benefits.
- Work in a high-performing Nordic tech organisation built on trust and responsibility.

How we support your journey

At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where youre respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture - and a business that never stands still - theres room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries.

Youll have real ownership of St1's CRM platform and how it's used, working with a wide range of teams; backed by competitive pay, a bonus scheme and genuine opportunities to grow your career.

If youd like to explore more about our culture, visit our career site.

What to expect after you apply

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and equitable recruitment process.

Interested? Send us your CV and cover letter via the Barona Career site ASAP. For more information, please reach out to Sr Consultant Arja Martikainen arja.martikainen@barona.fi.

title: Erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilöitä Helsinkiin
description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilöitä Helsinkiin.**

Haemme Helsingin alueelle erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilöitä tuleviin asiakkuuksiin. Rakennamme osaajaverkostoa kasvavaan palvelutarpeeseen, ja tarjoamme työtä asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaisesti. Tällä hetkellä asiakkaille myönnetyt palvelutunnit ovat vähintään 20 tuntia kuukaudessa, mutta tuntimäärät voivat vaihdella asiakkuuden mukaan.

Erityisen osallisuuden tuen tukihenkilönä mahdollistat asiakkaalle osallistumisen hänelle merkitykselliseen toimintaan. Työssä tuet asiakkaan vuorovaikutusta, osallisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä sekä kannustat häntä löytämään mielekästä tekemistä omien kiinnostuksenkohteidensa mukaisesti. Työssä korostuvat läsnäolo, kohtaamisen taito ja yksilöllinen ohjaus

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet helposti lähestyttävä, kärsivällinen ja aidosti kiinnostunut kohtaamaan erilaisia ihmisiä. Osaat toimia asiakkaan rinnalla kannustavasti ja hänen yksilöllisiä tarpeitaan kuunnellen. Sinulle on luontevaa tukea asiakkaan osallistumista arjen toimintoihin, harrastuksiin ja sosiaalisiin tilanteisiin sekä löytää yhdessä uusia mahdollisuuksia mielekkääseen tekemiseen.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES

- Joustavan työajan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Sosiaalialan koulutusta

- Kiinnostusta vammaistyöhön

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

- Selkeää vuorovaikutusta, läsnäoloa ja itsenäistä työotetta


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. EOT-tukihenkilön tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

title: Roof installer / roofing sheet metal worker
description:
Peltimestari – Helsingin Kattorakentajat Oy is looking for a roof installer for roof renovation projects in Helsinki and the surrounding metropolitan area. We specialise in standing seam metal roofs and demanding roofing sheet metal work.

Duties include roof removal and preparation work, installation of roofing materials, rainwater systems, roof safety products and sheet metal flashings, depending on your skills. You will work alongside experienced roofing sheet metal workers.

Pay is based on skills and experience in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. The starting date will be agreed with the selected applicant.

title: Unigraf: IT Manager
description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Espoo, hybrid

**Application deadline**: 18.10.2026

Unigraf is looking for an IT Manager to take ownership of a global IT environment and modernize their IT infrastructure!

Unigraf is a global leader in video electronics testing, developing advanced hardware and software tools for DisplayPort, HDMI, and USB-C technologies. The solutions are trusted by the worlds leading electronics manufacturers to ensure signal integrity, interoperability, and compliance — from R&D to production.

With decades of experience in embedded and test engineering, Unigraf has become a valued

technology partner for major industry players worldwide. Headquartered in Espoo, Finland, they are a team of 60 professionals with a strong international presence across Europe, the US, and Asia. Unigraf combines deep technical expertise with a hands-on, low-hierarchy culture — working on next-generation devices long before they reach the market and solving complex engineering challenges that shape the future of digital video technology.

**What will you be doing?**

As an IT Manager, you will take ownership of Unigrafs internal IT infrastructure and ensure that its global R&D organization has a reliable environment to work in. You will maintain and develop infrastructure connecting Unigrafs teams in Finland, India, and Taiwan.

Your responsibilities cover servers, networks and VPN connections, Windows domain environments, access and license management, and internal IT support. You will also drive infrastructure development projects, such as moving backups and storage to cloud services and modernizing existing solutions.

You will solve technical infrastructure challenges, work closely with experienced R&D professionals and Unigrafs external IT service provider, and have the opportunity to improve how things are done. We hope you are also interested in helping the software team with occasional scripting, automation, and software development depending on your skills and available time.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You are an experienced IT professional who enjoys taking ownership of a broad technical environment. You can independently investigate problems, design practical solutions, and communicate clearly with colleagues across different countries and technical backgrounds.

You are comfortable working hands-on with infrastructure while also looking ahead: identifying what should be modernized, automated, or moved to the cloud. An interest in scripting, AI tools, and software development will help you expand the role further over time.

**We require you to have:**

- A minimum of 5 years in a relevant infrastructure-focused role

- Strong understanding of server environments, networking, VPN technologies, and Windows domain environments

- Experience with Windows and Linux environments and managing user access, permissions, and IT infrastructure

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly Azure or AWS

- Scripting skills with Python or another relevant language, alongside experience with CI/CD or test automation environments

- Interest in using AI tools to improve infrastructure, integrations, automation, or development workflows

- Professional proficiency in English and strong communication skills with various stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Atlassian product knowledge

- C++ knowledge or motivation to develop your software development skills

- Finnish language skills


**Unigraf offers you:**

- A chance to take ownership of a broad global IT environment where your decisions have a visible impact on everyday R&D work

- Freedom and responsibility to shape and modernize Unigrafs infrastructure by introducing cloud services, automation, and better ways of working

- Highly experienced team of software engineers solving technical challenges around advanced hardware, software, and test environments

- An opportunity to participate in automation and software development

- A low-hierarchy company culture with flexibility and the autonomy to organize your work around clear responsibilities


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Unigraf. The position is based at Unigrafs office in Matinkylä, Espoo, with an expectation of working on-site at least three days per week, particularly during onboarding. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.

The initial salary range for this position is approximately 5000-6500 €/month depending on your experience. If your salary expectation falls outside this range, we would still like to hear from you.

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Manager Commerce Poissonnerie F/H
description:
Nous sommes.
Auchan Retail France, une entreprise de distribution de plus de collaborateurs au service de millions de clients chaque année.

Le poste de Manager Commerce Poissonnerie F/H (Niveau 7) est fait pour vous.
Rencontrons-nous !

- Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Marketing internationale du siège afin d'adapter les campagnes, contenus et initiatives globales au marché francophone.
- Être l'interface Marketing avec les équipes commerciales et les autres parties prenantes locales, afin d'identifier les besoins du marché et de soutenir le développement commercial.

Profil recherché

- Formation supérieure en marketing, communication, médias ou domaine équivalent.
- 3 ans minimum d’expérience professionnelle en marketing, idéalement dans un environnement B2B, en entreprise ou en agence.

- Expérience et forte appétence pour les campagnes digitales, les réseaux sociaux et l’organisation d’événements/webinaires.
- Capacité à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales et bonne compréhension des enjeux de génération et de gestion des leads.
- Excellente maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec de très bonnes qualités rédactionnelles.
- Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral (niveau B2 minimum), permettant de travailler efficacement dans un environnement international.  
- La connaissance de l'allemand constitue un atout.
- La connaissance d’outils CRM et/ou de marketing automation (Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, etc.) constitue un atout.

Vos qualités

- Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets et priorités simultanément
- Excellent relationnel et aisance à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement international.
- Esprit d'équipe, curiosité et proactivité.

Ce que nous proposons

- Un rôle varié et autonome, avec la possibilité de prendre des initiatives, de proposer vos idées et de contribuer concrètement au développement de SOFiSTiK sur le marché francophone.

- Des possibilités de formation et de développement professionnel, en fonction de votre expérience et de vos ambitions.
- Une organisation favorisant l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle, avec des horaires flexibles et la possibilité de télétravailler selon les modalités en vigueur.
- Une rémunération attractive complétée par des avantages sociaux (mutuelle, …).

****

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Directeur Régional Hôtellerie (H/F)
description:
Description du poste :

Piloter la stratégie commerciale de 8 hôtels, développer le business et faire rayonner la destination Lille.

Un cluster hôtelier ne se développe pas uniquement grâce à la force de ses marques.


Il grandit grâce à une stratégie commerciale claire, des équipes engagées, une lecture fine du marché et une capacité à transformer chaque opportunité en performance.


Au sein de WiZiU, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Directeur Commercial Lille NB/F/H pour piloter la stratégie commerciale de 8 hôtels multi enseignes , développer directement l'activité sur le marché lillois et accompagner les équipes dans leurs ambitions commerciales Ce que tu vas faire (et faire vivre au quotidien)

Tu définis et pilotes la stratégie commerciale du cluster en tenant compte des différents segments de marché, de la saisonnalité et des spécificités de chaque enseigne.


Tu contribues à la construction budgétaire et au suivi des projections de chiffre d'affaires, tout en accompagnant les évolutions stratégiques du portefeuille.


Tu restes également très présent(e) sur le terrain : prospection, rendez-vous clients, négociation, closing et développement d'un portefeuille Corporate, MICE et Groupes sur la place lilloise.


Tu pilotes directement le Group Desk , la Responsable Coordination Événementielle et l' Attachée Commerciale , et travailles en coordination étroite avec les Sales Manager/Commerciaux externes.


Tu fixes les priorités, accompagnes la performance de l'équipe et t'assures de la qualité du suivi commercial, des délais de réponse et de la conversion des opportunités.


Tu travailles au quotidien avec le Revenue Management pour partager le pipeline, arbitrer les opportunités et aligner stratégie commerciale et optimisation du revenu. Tu collabores également directement avec le Marketing pour activer les bons leviers sur le F&B, la visibilité digitale et les campagnes B2B.


Enfin, tu représentes WiZiU et ses hôtels auprès de l'écosystème économique et touristique lillois : acteurs institutionnels, réseaux d'entreprises, organisations professionnelles et partenaires de la destination Toi, tu es.

Tu as une expérience confirmée en direction commerciale hôtelière , idéalement sur un environnement multi-sites ou multi-marques.


Tu es avant tout un(e) commercial(e) de terrain : tu aimes prospecter, négocier, développer un réseau et closer.


Tu sais aussi prendre de la hauteur, construire une stratégie et accompagner une équipe dans sa performance.


Tu maîtrises les enjeux MICE, Groupes et Corporate , tu comprends les logiques de Revenue Management et tu sais travailler de manière fluide avec les équipes Marketing.


Tu es autonome, structuré(e), orienté(e) résultats et capable de passer naturellement d'un sujet stratégique à une problématique très opérationnelle.


Tu es à l'aise en anglais et tu as envie de prendre une place active dans l'écosystème économique lillois Pourquoi nous rejoindre.

Pour prendre la responsabilité commerciale d'un cluster de 8 hôtels aux enseignes fortes et complémentaires Pour occuper un rôle qui combine réellement stratégie, management et vente directe Pour travailler au cœur d'un environnement en transformation, avec des projets de repositionnement et d'évolution de marques.


Pour collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes Commerciales, Revenue, Marketing, Direction et Opérationnelles du Groupe.


Et surtout, pour avoir un impact direct sur le développement de WiZiU et de ses hôtels sur la place lilloise Tes avantages

- Bénéficiez d'une mutuelle prise en charge à 100 Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 60 Profitez du bénéfice des jours fériés dès 6 mois d'ancienneté chez WiZiU.
- Recevez une prime WiZconnect grâce à vos recommandations.
- Recevez la prime WiZtrust pour récompenser votre fidélité.
- Profitez de possibilités d'évolution au sein du Groupe.
- Bénéficiez du programme WiZdiscount avec des remises exclusives dans les hôtels, restaurants et SPA du Groupe WiZiU.


Chez WiZiU, chaque stratégie, chaque relation client et chaque opportunité transformée participent au développement de nos hôtels.


Derrière la performance d'un cluster, il y a aussi un(e) Directeur Commercial(e) capable de donner une direction, d'embarquer les équipes et de rester connecté(e) au terrain Salaire : 65 à 70K€ annuel + 15% variable.


Poste Cadre basé à Lille.

title: Customer support manager (h/f) (H/F)
description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Rejoignez Safran Aerosystems : leader international dans la sécurité aéronautique, la gestion des fluides et du carburant. Notre force ? Innover pour la sécurité des vols (oxygène, évacuation, flottabilité) et piloter la transition vers une aviation décarbonée grâce aux carburants durables. 6 200 collaborateurs, 7 pays et un seul objectif : un ciel plus sûr.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionSummary of Duties:

o Responsible for achieving customer satisfaction which is measured through Airframer & Internal Scorecards

o Building new and developing long-lasting relationships with customers

o Operate as the focal point for all matters specific to their customers

o Taking ownership of customers issues and following problems through to resolution

o Responsible for keeping accurate records and documenting customer support actions and discussions within CRM platform

o Perform on-site customer meetings as required ie Program Review Meetings (PRM),

Technical Review Meeting (TRM), and Executive Review Meetings (ERM) etc.

o Generate post visit reports and manage actions and commitments through to completion

o Generate Key Performance Indicators (KPI's)

o Analyze data to identify trends and areas of improvements

o Serve as the focal for performance claims: coordinate with warranty teams to validate claim data, negotiate settlement with customer, track claims

o Review, monitor and distribute customer(s) backlog reports, taking actions to prevent late deliveries.

o Support SCS Finance department in the recovery of late AR helping finance with the right POCs and addressing systemic/ repetitive issues for corrective actions.

o Awareness of customers internal issues which may affect the Safran Cabin Services business

o Feedback information to Safran Cabin Service sales team on new sales opportunities and Program teams on at-risk parts: PMA, Owner Operator Parts

o Awareness of customer support contractual obligations either through the Airframer contracts or specific contracts with a specific customer

o Support Field Technical Representatives performing cabin inspections and generating the associated reports

o Provide level 1 & 2 technical support using CMM's & technical drawings data

o Support STC working parties as required, support Entry into service (EIS) for new aircraft types

o Being available in accordance with constraints linked to aftermarket support domain

Leadership, autonomie, sens du service, réactivité et esprit entrepreneurial seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction.

Poste en CDI - Statut cadre
Localisation : Caen
Rémunération : fixe + variable selon profil et expérience

title: Planificateur de maintenance (H/F)
description:
L'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) d'Amazon est le garant de la performance opérationnelle de nos sites. En tant que Planificateur de Maintenance, vous jouerez un rôle stratégique au cœur de notre réseau. Vous serez l'expert(e) de la planification et de l'optimisation de nos ressources de maintenance, en anticipant les besoins avant qu'ils ne deviennent des problèmes.

Basé(e) sur l'un de nos sites opérationnels, vous maîtriserez notre système de gestion de la maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO) et assurerez la disponibilité optimale de nos équipements dans un environnement dynamique et innovant.

Key job responsibilities
- Excellence en sécurité: Garantir la conformité de tous les équipements aux normes européennes de sécurité. Planifier les maintenances préventives pour éliminer les risques avant qu'ils ne surviennent.
- Excellence opérationnelle: Optimiser l'allocation des ressources de maintenance via notre logiciel GMAO. Analyser en continu les performances des équipements et ajuster les niveaux de stock de pièces détachées. Assurer la fiabilité des données de maintenance et la précision des prévisions.
- Innovation & Amélioration Continue: Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration des processus de maintenance. Collaborer avec le réseau européen RME pour partager les meilleures pratiques.

Qualifications De Base
- Expérience préalable dans la planification et l'audit d'activités de maintenance ; créations de gammes de maintenance
- Maîtrise d'un logiciel GMAO
- Expérience en gestion d'inventaires de pièces détachées
- Bonne maîtrise de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Maîtrise de l'anglais (CEFR C1 ou supérieur, écrit et oral)

Qualifications Appréciées
- Compréhension des systèmes de contrôle basés sur des automates et des exigences de conformité statutaire
- Expérience de l'utilisation de systèmes informatisés de gestion de la maintenance pour planifier la maintenance et consigner les tâches
- Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

title: MANAGER DE CUISINE (H/F)
description:
Rejoignez PROVDEV, une société dynamique spécialisée dans la restauration rapide de qualité.                                                                               Nous exploitons l'enseigne La Famille (Finest Lunch) au cœur de la zone d'activités de la Duranne à Aix-en-Provence.
Spécialisés dans le concept de "Finest Lunch", nous proposons une cuisine fraîche, gourmande et variée (bowls, wraps, sandwichs, salades et livraison de kebabs).
Notre ambition est d'offrir une expérience de restauration rapide premium à notre clientèle, en alliant rapidité de service et excellence des produits.

VOTRE RÔLE ET VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT
Véritable pilier de l'établissement, vous prendrez la direction d'une équipe dynamique de 8 personnes.
Au quotidien, vous évoluerez dans un environnement exigeant où l'équipe s'attache à :
- Préparer les ingrédients et les plats selon nos recettes établies.
- Assurer la propreté et l'organisation constante de l'espace de travail.
- Respecter scrupuleusement les normes de sécurité alimentaire et d'hygiène.
- Collaborer étroitement pour garantir un service rapide et efficace.

VOS MISSIONS PRINCIPALES
En tant que Manager, votre rôle est de conjuguer excellence opérationnelle et leadership humain. Vos missions se déclinent en cinq axes majeurs :
- Management et Leadership : Coordonner l'équipe, assurer la cohésion et piloter la formation continue de vos collaborateurs.
- Supervision Opérationnelle : Veiller à la fluidité du service, gérer les périodes de forte activité ("coups de feu") et soutenir vos équipes sur le terrain.
- Contrôle Qualité : Garantir que chaque plat respecte scrupuleusement les fiches techniques et les standards de qualité élevés de l'enseigne.
- Gestion de l'Hygiène et de la Sécurité : Être le/la garant(e) de l'application stricte des normes HACCP au sein de la cuisine.
- Gestion des Stocks : Suivre les inventaires, piloter les commandes fournisseurs et mettre en œuvre des actions de lutte contre le gaspillage alimentaire.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ
- Vous possédez une expérience confirmée en management d'équipe de cuisine.
- Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les normes d'hygiène HACCP.
- Vous faites preuve d'un leadership naturel et d'une grande capacité de gestion du stress.
- Votre rigueur et votre sens de l'organisation vous permettent de garantir une qualité constante, fidèle à l'image de marque de notre enseigne.

Prêt(e) à faire saliver le monde de l'entreprise à Aix-en-Provence ? Envoyez-nous votre candidature dès maintenant !

title: Ingénieur Avant-Vente Défense et Sécurité F/H
description:

Elle est dédiée à l'intégration et la conception de solutions numériques innovantes, répondant aux enjeux cruciaux des acteurs du monde de la défense et de la sécurité intérieure/civile.

Notre équipe pluridisciplinaire, composée d'experts en avant-vente, vente, think/build/run et intégration de services digitaux, collabore étroitement avec les différentes filiales du groupe Orange pour offrir des solutions sur mesure et performantes?: connectivité fixe-mobile-satellite, hébergement de données/cloud, IA, développement applicatif, cybersécurité avec Orange Cyberdefense.

Nous valorisons l'innovation, l'agilité et l'engagement au service de nos clients, tout en cultivant un environnement de travail inclusif et stimulant.
