Unser multiprofessionelles Team besteht aus Sozialpädagogen/-innen, Erzieher/-innen, Psychologe/-in, Krankenschwester, Heilpädagogin und einer Werkanleiterin.

Für unsere stationäre Intensivwohngruppe suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sozialpädagogen, Sozialarbeiter, BA Soziales, Erzieher (m/w/d), in Voll- oder Teilzeit (inkl. Nachtdienst)

title: Koch (w/m/d) in Teilzeit (30h/Woche) im Kinderhaus Kirschenallee, Moers (Koch/Köchin)
description:
Der SCI-Moers ist eine Non-Profit-Organisation, die ihr Motto „Wir gestalten soziale Ideen“ seit über 40 Jahren erfolgreich und auf vielfältige Weise umsetzt.

Unser "Kinderhaus Kirschenallee“ in Moers (https://www.sci-moers.de/kinder/kinderhaus-kirschenallee/) wurde 1994 als eine der ersten inklusiven Kindertageseinrichtungen in Moers und Umgebung eröffnet. Wir betreuen zurzeit Kinder in fünf Gruppen im Alter von 1 bis 6 Jahren.

title: Lehrer / Sonderpädagoge (m/w/d) – auch im Quereinstieg (Lehrer/in - Waldorfschulen)
description:
Über uns

„Wir gestalten soziale Ideen“ – so lautet der Kernsatz unseres Wirkens. Dahinter stecken viele verschiedene Projekte, von der Arbeitsförderung über die Kinder- und Jugendhilfe bis hin zu Inklusionsbetrieben. Als Teil der weltweiten Bewegung des Service Civil International treten wir für soziale Gerechtigkeit und benachteiligte Gruppen ein und fördern die Verständigung zwischen Menschen mit unterschiedlichen sozialen und ethnischen Hintergründen.

Die sci:moers gGmbH ist ein anerkannter gemeinnütziger Träger und Mitglied im Paritätischen Wohlfahrtsverband. Hervorgegangen ist die Gesellschaft aus der Arbeit des Service Civil International Moers e. V., dieser wurde als Lokalverein des Service Civil International 1979 in Moers gegründet.

Die SCI:Gemeinschaftsschule ist eine freie Ganztagssschule, in der auf der Grundlage der von Rudolf Steiner entwickelten Waldorfpädagogik Kinder mit unterschiedlichen Begabungsprofilen, Lern- und Lebenserfahrungen gemeinsam unterrichtet werden.

Ihr Profil

- Als ausgebildete Lehrkraft: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Staatsexamen oder einen gleichwertig anerkannten Abschluss.
- Im Quereinstieg: Sie verfügen über einen Abschluss auf Diplom- bzw. Master-Niveau in einem unterrichtsrelevanten Fachgebiet.
- Als ausgebildete Lehrkraft für sonderpädagogische Förderung: Sie verfügen über einen Master-Abschluss (Master of Education) als Lehrkraft für sonderpädagogische Förderung oder einen gleichwertig anerkannten Abschluss, idealerweise mit abgeschlossenem Staatsexamen.
- Eine waldorfpädagogische Grundbildung bzw. eine Ausbildung zur Waldorflehrkraft ist wünschenswert – aber keine Voraussetzung.
- Auch ohne Vorerfahrung in der Waldorfpädagogik sind Sie bei uns willkommen: Im Rahmen unserer schulischen Konferenzen vermitteln wir die Grundlagen, reflektieren diese gemeinsam und entwickeln sie als Team kontinuierlich weiter.
- Sie haben Freude daran, Kinder in ihrer Entwicklung zu begleiten, und bringen Offenheit für neue pädagogische Wege mit.
- Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind flexibel und möchten Schule aktiv mitgestalten.
- Engagement, Neugier und die Bereitschaft, sich in einem multiprofessionellen Umfeld einzubringen, zeichnen Sie aus.

Unser Angebot

- Entwicklung, die zu Ihnen passt: Vielfältige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten – fachlich wie persönlich
- Flexibilität im Alltag: Wir berücksichtigen Ihre individuellen Lebensumstände bei der Dienstplanung
- Faire Bezahlung: Vergütung in Anlehnung an den TV-L
- Schneller Einstieg: Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
- Gemeinsam wachsen: Arbeiten Sie in einem engagierten, multiprofessionellen Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und inspiriert
- Mitgestalten statt nur umsetzen: Bringen Sie Ihre Ideen aktiv in die Schulentwicklung ein und prägen Sie unsere Schule mit
- Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Begleiten Sie Kinder auf ihrem individuellen Weg und gestalten Sie Bildung aktiv mit

Für diese Einrichtung gilt das Masernschutzgesetz, eine Beschäftigung ist nur mit gültigem Nachweis der Masernimmunität / Masernschutzimpfungen (zweifach) für nach 1970 Geborene möglich.

title: Pädagogische Fachkraft (gn) stationäre Jugendhilfe (TVöD) – Alpenblick (Erzieher/in - Jugend- und Heimerziehung)
employer: imBlick Kinder-u.Jugendhilfe imblick Kinder- und Jugendhilf imblick Kinder- und Jugendhilf
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Pädagoge

Stellenbeschreibung:
Pädagogische Fachkraft / Erzieher (gn) Wohngruppe – Landkreis Lindau (Bodensee)

Die Sonne scheint, der Himmel ist blau und Sie fragen sich: Gibt's im Landkreis Lindau einen Ort, an dem Pädagogik noch atmen kann?  Ja. Gibt’s!  In unserer therapeutisch-pädagogischen Wohngruppe leben sieben Kinder und Jugendliche, die genau eines brauchen: Verlässliche Bezugspersonen, die Struktur stiften und echte Geborgenheit vermitteln. Machen wir uns nix vor. Unsere Kids schleppen alle eine heftige Biografie mit sich rum. Wir suchen deshalb keine Aufsichtskräfte für die bloße Verwahrung. Wir suchen Menschen, die den ganz normalen Alltagswahnsinn aktiv mitgestalten und Krisen als Beziehungsarbeit begreifen.

Sie sind da, wenn es brennt, fangen emotionale Ausbrüche auf und zeigen, wie faires Konfliktlösen in der Praxis funktioniert.

Das Setting lebt von Ihrer Persönlichkeit. Egal ob Musik, Sport oder Handwerk – Ihre eigenen Hobbys fließen direkt in den Gruppenalltag ein. Sie begleiten die Jugendlichen Schritt für Schritt in die Selbstständigkeit, unterstützen sie in der Schule, im Beruf und bei der eigenen Identitätsfindung.

Das Fundament unserer Arbeit beruht auf klar definierten Meilensteinen.

* Stabilisierung: Wir erarbeiten gemeinsam ein angemessenes Konfliktlösungsverhalten und stärken die Identität der Jugendlichen.

* Perspektive: Die Jugendlichen erhalten eine unterstützende Begleitung in Schule und Beruf für eine selbstbestimmte Zukunft.

Professioneller Einsatz verlangt exzellente Rahmenbedingungen.

Unsere Vergütung erfolgt nach den Strukturen des TVöD, ergänzt durch umfassende Zusatzleistungen.
Sie erhalten 30 Tage Urlaub :) plus zwei feste, zusätzliche Entlastungstage im Jahr. Für unserer aller Psychohygiene bieten wir regelmäßige Supervisionen und maßgeschneiderte Weiterbildungen an. Modernste Benefits wie ein persönliches Jobbike und das Deutschland-Ticket sichern Ihre Mobilität vor Ort. Ein echter Bonus unseres Trägers: Unser eigenes Ferienhaus in den Bergen steht dem Team für private Auszeiten zur Verfügung.

Lassen Sie uns reden. Direkt am Telefon oder bei einem Kaffee in der Gruppe.

title: Manager SAP Basis Solutions (m/w/d) (ERP-Berater/in - ERP-Consultant)
description:
Ihre nächste SAP-Basis-Rolle sollte mehr sein als der stabile Betrieb von Systemen.

Wenn Sie seit mehreren Jahren im SAP-Basis-Umfeld arbeiten, kennen Sie die klassischen Aufgaben:

Systeme überwachen.
Transporte steuern.
Störungen beheben.
Upgrades durchführen.
Den Betrieb stabil halten.

Alles wichtige Aufgaben.

Doch was wäre, wenn Ihre nächste Position Ihnen die Möglichkeit gibt, eine globale SAP-Landschaft aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und ihre technologische Zukunft mitzugestalten?

Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen mit langfristiger, familiengeprägter Unternehmenskultur suchen wir einen erfahrenen Manager SAP Basis Solutions (m/w/d) am Standort Mannheim.

Die SAP-Landschaft umfasst SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA sowie moderne SAP-Plattformen und befindet sich in einer kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung hin zu einer stärker integrierten, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen Systemlandschaft.

Die Position richtet sich an jemanden, der über die klassische Administration hinaus Verantwortung übernehmen möchte, für Stabilität, Sicherheit, Performance, Automatisierung und technologische Weiterentwicklung.

Aufgaben

Was macht diese Position besonders?

Sie verantworten nicht einfach ein einzelnes SAP-System.

Sie arbeiten in einer globalen und sich weiterentwickelnden SAP-Plattformlandschaft und verbinden operativen Betrieb mit Technologie, Transformation und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

- Sicherstellung des stabilen, sicheren und performanten Betriebs der globalen SAP-Systemlandschaft inklusive SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA und weiterer SAP-Plattformen
- Operative SAP-Basisadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Systemmonitoring, Transport-, Job-, Druck- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie Performanceanalyse und Troubleshooting
- Planung und technische Umsetzung von Upgrades, Releasewechseln, Migrationen, Systemkopien, Templates und internationalen Rollout-Projekten
- Administration und Weiterentwicklung moderner SAP-Plattformen wie SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Cloud ALM und SAP RISE Private Cloud Edition
- Koordination und fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister, Hosting-Provider und SAP-Berater sowie Sicherstellung der vereinbarten Servicequalität
- Technische Begleitung von SAP-Systemvermessungen sowie Analyse der SAP-Lizenznutzung zur Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen
- Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung der SAP-Betriebsprozesse mit Fokus auf Verfügbarkeit, Security, Compliance, Performance und Zukunftsfähigkeit

Kurz gesagt:

Sie sorgen nicht nur dafür, dass die SAP-Landschaft heute funktioniert.
Sie helfen dabei, sie für morgen besser, sicherer und automatisierter zu machen.

Qualifikation

Was sollten Sie mitbringen?

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit fundierter SAP-Basis-Expertise und Interesse an modernen SAP-Technologien.

Sie bringen idealerweise mit:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
- Praktische Erfahrung in der SAP-Basisadministration sowie im Betrieb komplexer SAP-ECC- und SAP-S/4HANA-Systemlandschaften
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP NetWeaver und SAP HANA, insbesondere in Monitoring, Transportmanagement, Systemkopien, Upgrades, Migrationen und Troubleshooting
- Erfahrung mit hybriden SAP-Landschaften sowie modernen SAP-Technologien wie SAP BTP und SAP Cloud ALM; Kenntnisse in SAP RISE Private Cloud Edition sind von Vorteil
- Kenntnisse in SAP Security, Rollen und Berechtigungen, Zertifikatsmanagement, Hochverfügbarkeit sowie Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten
- Erfahrung mit technischer SAP-Systemvermessung und der Bewertung der Lizenznutzung
- Erfahrung in der Koordination und fachlichen Steuerung externer Service Provider
- Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Sie müssen nicht jede einzelne Technologie perfekt beherrschen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams des Frankfurter Ausbildungsprojekts suchen wir zum 01.11.2026 Sie als Beratungsfachkraft!

Sozialpädagog:in (m/w/d) als Beratungsfachkraft im Übergang Schule-Beruf an Förderschulen (Teilzeit / 19,5 Wochenstunden)

Im Frankfurter Ausbildungsprojekt beraten wir Schüler:innen der Abgangsklassen des Haupt- und Realschulzweigs sowie an Förderschulen beim Übergang von der Schule in den Beruf. Wir unterstützen sie in Einzelberatungsgesprächen bei der beruflichen Orientierung sowie der Ausbildungsplatzsuche.

Arbeitszeit:
Die vertragliche Wochenarbeitszeit beträgt 19,5 Stunden. Während der Schulzeit arbeiten Sie bis zu 21 Stunden pro Woche. Für Ihr Engagement erhalten Sie Freizeitausgleich. Die Mehrstunden werden in den Schulferien durch 15 zusätzliche freie Tage ausgeglichen. So sind Sie genau dann für die Schüler:innen da, wenn Ihre Unterstützung gefragt ist – und profitieren selbst von zusätzlichen freien Tagen.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Studien– oder Berufsabschluss im sozial- oder sonderpädagogischen Bereich, idealerweise Fachexpertise im Förderschwerpunkt Lernen
- Erfahrung in der Beratungsarbeit mit Schüler:innen mit sonderpädagogischem Förderbedarf wünschenswert
- Kenntnisse des beruflichen und schulischen Bildungssystems im Rhein-Main-Gebiet
- Kenntnisse des regionalen Ausbildungs- und Arbeitsmarktes und geförderter Programme
- Flexibilität, Kooperationsbereitschaft und Teamfähigkeit
- Fähigkeit zum selbstständigen Arbeiten und sicheres verbindliches Auftreten
- Beherrschung gängiger MS-Office Standardsoftware

Ihr Profil

- Zielgruppe: Schüler:innen der 8., 9. und 10. Klasse an zwei Förderschulen mit Förderschwerpunkt Lernen
- Berufliche Orientierung und Vermittlung in geförderte und ungeförderte Ausbildung sowie in Maßnahmen; für Klasse 8: Orientierung und Vorbereitung auf Praktika
- Individuelle Begleitung der Schüler:innen in Einzelberatung zu folgenden Themenbereichen: Auseinandersetzung mit den eigenen Stärken, Fähigkeiten, Interessen und Kompetenzen, berufliche Orientierung, Bewerbungsprozess zu Praktika und Ausbildung, Motivation der Schüler:innen, sich mit der beruflichen Zukunft zu beschäftigen
- Kooperation mit der Lehrkraft im berufsorientierenden Unterricht (Klassenformat): Begleitung einzelner Schüler:innen im Unterricht, niedrigschwellige Beratung im Lernkontext, Ermöglichen von Praxisbezügen
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Lehrkräften an den Schulen und der (Reha-)Berufsberatung, sowie Kontakt zu Ausbildungsbetrieben und Maßnahmeträgern
- Dokumentation der Beratungsarbeit

Wir bieten

- Ein starkes Team: Sie profitieren von einem gut vernetzten Träger und einem kollegialen Miteinander.
- Gestaltungsfreiraum: Wir bieten kurze Abstimmungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen.
- Guter Einstieg: Sie erhalten eine übergreifende Einarbeitung durch Ihre Bereichsleitung. Die tägliche Beratungsarbeit lernen Sie im Tandem mit einem erfahrenen Teammitglied kennen.

title: Fullstack Engineer I, Dmarts – Quick Commerce (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

Code. Culture. Teamwork. As a Software Engineer I (Fullstack), you'll contribute to the systems that keep inventory moving across Delivery Hero's Quick Commerce supply chain — from purchase orders and store transfers to distribution center operations and WMS integrations. You'll work full-stack across Golang, Python and React, learning from experienced engineers while shipping features that directly support planners and operations teams every day.

Our team builds technology that enables inventory to move efficiently across our supply chain network (from procurement and replenishment to distribution centers, stores and other inventory movements). We develop systems used by planners and operational teams to manage Purchase Orders, Store Transfers, Cross Dock operations and Returns, while also building capabilities around Distribution Centers operations, inventory visibility and integrations with internal and external Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Our tech stack goes from Golang and Python in the backend to React/Typescript on the frontend. We are progressively adopting Golang for new backend and event-driven components while continuing to evolve our existing Python services.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- Contribute to the development of fullstack applications, working across backend services (Golang/Python) and frontend interfaces (React)
- Work with experienced engineers to design and deliver features supporting inventory movements, Distribution Center operations and WMS integrations
- Build and consume REST APIs and event-driven integrations, including Kafka-based workflows
- Contribute throughout the software lifecycle, including implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability and production support
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers and operational stakeholders to understand problems and turn them into reliable software solutions
- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, while continuously improving your knowledge of distributed systems, cloud technologies and software engineering practices

Qualifications

- Initial professional experience in software development through junior roles, internships, working student positions or relevant projects, with solid foundations in software design, data structures and algorithms
- Experience with at least one backend programming language; Golang or Python is particularly relevant, with an interest in developing further across both
- Familiarity with modern frontend development using Javascript/Typescript and React or a comparable framework
- Understanding of REST APIs, relational databases/SQL, Git and automated testing as part of modern software development
- A collaborative and proactive mindset, with willingness to work across the stack, learn from feedback, take increased ownership and use modern development practices and AI-assisted tooling responsibly

Nice to have

- Exposure to distributed or event-driven systems and message queues such as Kafka
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
- Awareness of CI/CD pipelines and observability practices in production environments

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

description:
CCP is looking for a Graphics Programmer with a deep passion for games and visual craft to join the EVE Online art team in our Reykjavík studio.

You will work closely with artists and engineers to bring stunning visuals to life, developing shaders, rendering features, and tools that directly shape the look and feel of EVE Online.

Design and implement new graphical features, shaders, and visual solutions that enhance EVE Online’s signature look.
Work closely with artists to understand their needs and deliver tools and workflows that empower their creativity.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.

description:
Introduction

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

The role is based at Meitheal Mara’s offices at Crosses Green House, Cork and is offered on a contract of indefinite duration, subject to continued funding. Il ruolo - Svolgere la manutenzione ordinaria sul parco impianti assegnato. - Rispondere tempestivamente alle chiamate assegnate, essere disponibile per la copertura di chiamate durante l' orario di lavoro e al servizio di reperibilità. - Eseguire ogni tipologia di intervento di manutenzione e riparazione, anche di minore entità. - Relazionarsi con il cliente, all'arrivo e al termine della manutenzione, aggiornandolo circa le condizioni dell'impianto. Il profilo - Esperienza pregressa, anche minima, nel settore, - Preferibile il possesso del diploma ad indirizzo tecnico, - Orientamento al cliente e al risultato, capacità relazionale, flessibilità, spirito d'iniziativa. - Disponibilità alla reperibilità. - Essere in possesso del patentino per la manutenzione ascensori. L'offerta Cosa offre OTIS: Inserimento con contratto CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria - livello C3. Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da € 32.000; il pacchetto complessivo potrà essere definito in misura superiore in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze tecniche e del livello di seniority della candidatura. Percorsi strutturati di sviluppo professionale e salary review in funzione di esperienza, performance e competenze maturate. Pacchetto articolato di benefit aziendali e contrattuali, comprensivo di Premio di Risultato, welfare aziendale, Fondo sanitario Metasalute, ticket restaurant da € 11, accordo integrativo di secondo livello, Employee Assistance Program / Programma di Assistenza ai Dipendenti, corsi gratuiti di lingua inglese e iniziative dedicate allo sviluppo delle competenze personali e manageriali. title: elettricista nel settore dell’illuminazione pubblica
description: Hai una passione per la meccanica e la tecnologia? Potremmo avere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda leader mondiale di carta per cartone ondulato e carte speciali siamo alla ricerca di un Manutentore Elettrico che supporti l'area della Manutenzione Elettrica. La risorsa lavorerà all'interno di un team strutturato di manutentori elettrici e nel corso delle diverse attività si interfaccerà con stakeholders interni ed esterni. Compiti Principali: - Riparazioni di emergenza richieste dall'assistente di turno in assenza del capo officina. - Mantenimento della struttura elettrica e delle cabine di distribuzione. - Lavorazioni in quota su carroponti e piattaforme aeree articolate e fisse. - Mantenimento e applicazione di tutti gli aspetti legati a 'igiene e sicurezza personali e collettivi'. Requisiti: - Conoscenza delle regole e leggi fondamentali del settore elettrico - Conoscenza e capacità tecniche sui sistemi trifase, circuiti di comando, circuiti ausiliari e di potenza - Conoscenza dei sistemi di automazione industriale, P.L.C., inverter, strumenti di misura elettrici - Conoscenza base dei sistemi informatici - Disponibilità a lavorare su turnazione a ciclo continuo e discontinuo - Gradita esperienza in contesti produttivi nei settori cartari o cartotecnici - Diploma preferibilmente in ambito tecnico - Preferibilmente possesso di attestati antincendio, primo soccorso, BLSD, piattaforma aerea, PES-PAV - Soft Skills: flessibilità, adattabilità, problem solving, buone doti relazionali e attitudine a lavorare in team Offerta Contrattuale: Contratto a tempo indeterminato con Gi Group (durata missione 6 mesi), finalizzato all'inserimento in azienda. title: direttore commerciale/direttrice commerciale
description: Il nostro Cliente, rappresentativa azienda operante nel settore della componentistica in metallo per il settore automotive, truck ed elettrodomestico ci ha incaricato di ricercare: SALES MANAGER Il Candidato avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare e consolidare il business aziendale, gestendo i rapporti con clienti, partner e stakeholder del settore, individuando nuove opportunità commerciali e contribuendo alla crescita dell'azienda. Principali Responsabilità - Gestire e sviluppare il portafoglio clienti assegnato, con particolare focus su clienti strategici del settore automotive, sia in ambito nazionale che internazionale. - Individuare nuove opportunità di business e sviluppare relazioni commerciali di lungo periodo con nuovi clienti e partner industriali. - Condurre trattative commerciali complesse, dalla fase di primo contatto fino alla negoziazione e chiusura degli accordi, assicurando il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita. - Mantenere e sviluppare relazioni con decision maker e stakeholder chiave delle aziende clienti, consolidando una rete di contatti strategici nel settore. - Collaborare con le funzioni interne (engineering, produzione, qualità e supply chain) per garantire la corretta industrializzazione dei progetti e l'allineamento tra esigenze del cliente e capacità produttive aziendali. - Supportare la definizione delle strategie commerciali e contribuire alla pianificazione delle attività di sviluppo del mercato - Monitorare l'andamento del mercato, dei competitor e delle tendenze del settore automotive, fornendo analisi e report periodici. - Partecipare a fiere, eventi di settore e incontri con clienti in Italia e all'estero. Requisiti - Diploma e/o Laurea ad indirizzo tecnico - Esperienza consolidata maturata in ruoli analoghi (Sales Manager, Account Manager, Key Account Manager) in aziende strutturate, possibilmente in ambito internazionale, del settore automotive. - Utilizzo dei principali tools informatici - Ottima conoscenza della lingua Inglese e di una seconda lingua tra francese e/o tedesco. - Approccio proattivo al mercato di riferimento e spiccata attitudine allo sviluppo del business - Capacità negoziali, capacità di ascolto e di analisi dei bisogni dei clienti - Attitudine relazionale e comunicativa con stakeholders a differenti livelli - Capacità di lavorare in team, orientamento al risultato e leadership ne completano il profilo. Sede di lavoro di riferimento: Veneto Centrale con disponibilità a svolgere trasferte/spostamenti presso le sedi dei clienti ubicate prevalentemente in Europa. Inquadramento: Tempo Indeterminato Range Retributivo offerto: RAL 65.000 -80.000 € + company car Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. title: addetto all’informazione e all’assistenza dei clienti/addetta all’informazione e all’assistenza dei clienti
description: Gi Group cerca per il potenziamento del team commerciale di un'azienda di Medole un/a Addetto/a al Back Office Estero con ottima conoscenza delle lingue inglese e francese. Principali responsabilità: Gestione degli ordini, dall'inserimento alla spedizione. Contatto quotidiano con clienti e distributori esteri (email e telefono). Supporto alla rete vendita e preparazione delle offerte commerciali. Requisiti minimi: Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese e della lingua francese (scritte e parlate). Esperienza pregressa (anche breve) in ruoli di back office o customer service estero. Ottima padronanza del Pacchetto Office (in particolare Excel). title: operatore di catene di montaggio automatizzate/operatrice di catene di montaggio automatizzate
description: Ti piace lavorare in squadra? Vuoi essere parte integrante del processo produttivo? Noi di Gi Group, filiale di SALERNO, cerchiamo per azienda cliente del settore settore elettrotecnico/industriale dei cavi: OPERAI PRODUZIONE CAVI Di cosa ti dovrai occupare? Preparazione della linea: predisposizione bobine/rocchetti, caricamento materie prime (conduttori, isolanti/guaina), set-up base e cambio formato seguendo le istruzioni del conduttore. Avviamento e conduzione in affiancamento: supporto durante start/stop, controllo che il materiale scorra correttamente, segnalazione anomalie (strappi, fuori misura, difetti superficiali). Controlli qualità in linea: verifiche semplici e registrazioni (es. diametro/spessore, continuità visiva, etichettatura, lunghezze), con eventuale isolamento del non conforme. Gestione bobine e movimentazione: sostituzione bobine finite, predisposizione nuove bobine, imballo/legatura, identificazione lotti e tracciabilità (etichette/ordine di produzione). Pulizia e manutenzione ordinaria: riordino post-lavorazione, pulizia area e componenti, piccole attività di routine (lubrificazione/controlli base) e segnalazione guasti alla manutenzione. Sicurezza e procedure: uso DPI, rispetto procedure HSE, attenzione a parti in movimento e carichi; collaborazione nel passaggio consegne tra turni. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Esperienza pregressa in linea di produzione Affidabilità e precisione. Attenzione a sicurezza, qualità e ordine. Spirito di collaborazione e rispetto delle regole. Flessibilità, capacità di adattarsi a ritmi produttivi variabili Ti rivedi in queste caratteristiche? Candidati ora! Orario di lavoro: Full-Time 40h dal lunedì al venerdì Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di somministrazione a tempo determinato. CCNL applicato: Gomma e Plastica Industria Livello di inquadramento: liv. I Retribuzione prevista: 25000k Luogo di lavoro: SALERNO Diventa parte fondamentale di un reparto produttivo! title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: assistente alle risorse umane
description: Hai una mente analitica e ti appassiona lavorare con i dati? Cerchi lavoro in ambito finanziario? Grafton Office è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt

- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico, livello D1.   • stalnu podršku 24/7 od strane tima matične tvrtke Inoxmont-VS

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.
Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Pirkimo pusė.

Tiekėjų paieška: metalo apdirbimo ir gamybos įmonės, statybos ir demontavimo objektai, laivų
remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.
Objektų apžiūra vietoje: kiek medžiagos, kokios rūšies ir būklės, ar ją reikės pjaustyti, kaip bus
kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.

title: Head of Vendor Management &  Outsourcing (m/f)
description:
Head of Vendor Management & Outsourcing (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1172

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

The Head of Vendor Management and Outsourcing is responsible for defining and executing the Bank's vendor strategy framework and leading end-to-end commercial, contractual, and regulatory vendor management activities. The role acts as the Finance-led control tower across the vendor lifecycle, ensuring financial discipline, contractual control, and regulatory compliance while optimizing vendor value and supporting outsourcing decisions.

Your next challenge:

• Define and maintain vendor segmentation (strategic / critical / commodity) and steer the vendor portfolio.
• Act as the Outsourcing Activity Manager and represent the Bank towards the Regulator on outsourcing.
• Support outsourcing and make-or-buy decisions and monitor vendor concentration and exposure.
• Own budgeting, forecasting, cost control, benchmarking and value realization for vendor spend.
• Establish and maintain comprehensive reportings, leveraging data analytics to drive decision-making, monitor performance, and provide actionable insights.
• Lead contract negotiation, lifecycle management, renewal and commercial governance.
• Act as primary commercial face to vendor and manage relationships with strategic vendors and group entities.
• Ensure compliance with DORA, EBA and CSSF requirements and maintain outsourcing register.
• Establish end-to-end vendor lifecycle governance and coordinate with CIO, Procurement, Legal and Risk.
• Lead change management initiatives related to vendor and outsourcing processes, and educate internal stakeholders on best practices, regulatory requirements, and risk awareness.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning, provide mentoring and coaching to team members, and promote knowledge sharing and best practices within the team.
• Maintain strong first line operational risk controls by overseeing vendor, facility and infrastructure processes, ensuring compliance with internal policies and escalating operational or safety risks.

Your skills:

• Master's degree in Business, Finance or Engineering.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in vendor management, procurement or outsourcing in regulated environment.
• Knowledge of DORA, EBA Outsourcing Guidelines and CSSF frameworks.
• Strong negotiation and financial management capabilities.
• Strong understanding of IT vendor management, including vendor selection, contract management, performance monitoring, and relationship management.
• Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with a data-driven approach to strategy development.
• Demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives, business transformation programs, and organizational change at a senior level.
• Languages: English and French are required. Proficiency in any additional language would be considered as an asset.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
The Luxembourg Eco-hydrological Observatory combines expertise in mechatronics, drone services, hydro-meteorological monitoring, and database management to provide comprehensive environmental monitoring solutions for research and institutional partners. A key asset is LIST's long-standing hydro-meteorological network in the Alzette and Sûre River basins, operating since 1995 and covering 40 nested catchments across diverse spatial and physiographical settings.
You will lead the operational, administrative, and strategic management of the Luxembourg Eco-hydrological Observatory, with the objective of ensuring the effective delivery and visibility of its expertise and services. In this role, you will combine leadership in field operations, environmental data and database management, mechatronics, and institutional representation.
More specifically, your key duties and responsibilities will consist of:
• Operational Management
- Plan, coordinate, and oversee all field activities, e.g., environmental monitoring, sampling campaigns, and on-site data collection.
- Supervise the deployment and maintenance of complex sensor networks.
- Ensure that field operations are carried out efficiently, safely, and in compliance with established protocols and quality standards.
• Data and Database Management
- Manage environmental databases, including data collection workflows, validation, storage, maintenance, and accessibility.
- Ensure data quality (i.e., integrity, consistency, and traceability) in line with scientific and regulatory requirements.
- Coordinate with the IT team to support continuous improvement of data management systems.
• Administrative and Organizational Responsibilities
- Perform and oversee administrative tasks, e.g., planning, reporting, budgeting support, and coordination with internal services.
- Contribute to operational planning and ensure proper documentation of observatory activities.
• Development and Promotion of Know-how
- Promote and market know-how, methodologies, and services to external stakeholders, partners, and clients.
- Represent the observatory professionally, ensuring alignment with institutional strategies and objectives.
- Act in the interest of the organization by promoting collective expertise.

- Team and operational management
- Proven ability to manage complex activities spanning fieldwork, data systems, and administration.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.
