Job description

Join Amaris Consulting as a Software Verification Engineer in Gothenburg, within our Engineering scope, and contribute to the development and validation of software solutions for the automotive sector. In this role, you will support diagnostic, testing, calibration, and verification activities for vehicle applications, working closely with technical teams to ensure reliable and efficient software and system performance.

Your missions

    Develop and verify software operations for diagnostic, testing, and calibration activities.
    Design and implement fault-tracing steps for off-board diagnostics solutions.
    Define troubleshooting strategies for Diagnostic Trouble Codes and relevant vehicle symptoms.
    Analyze dependencies between vehicle functions, software components, diagnostic tools, and aftermarket use cases.
    Perform verification activities on test rigs and complete vehicles.
    Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams to deliver effective software and aftermarket solutions.
    Interpret engineering specifications and translate them into software verification and diagnostic operations.
    Contribute actively to Agile development practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

Your profile

    Minimum 4 to 5 years of hands-on experience in embedded software development, software verification, or diagnostics, preferably within the automotive sector.
    Experience with Grade-X, aftermarket diagnostics tools, or aftermarket technology.
    Solid understanding of electrical systems architecture, embedded systems, and complete vehicle-level diagnostics.
    Experience with software testing, verification methods, and test environments.
    Ability to read, analyze, and implement engineering specifications.
    Experience working in an Agile team setup.
    Academic background in engineering, embedded systems, automotive systems, electronics, software development, or a related field.
    English fluent, both written and spoken.
    Strong analytical mindset and ability to solve complex technical issues.
    Strong collaboration skills in cross-functional environments.

What we offer

    An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities.
    An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities.
    A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules.
    A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events, including afterworks and team buildings.
    At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Who are Benifex? 💚💜

We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀

Why should you apply? 🌟

-Join a collaborative software engineering community across Sweden and the UK, where you’ll shape ways of working and drive continuous improvement together.

-Be empowered to take ownership - this is a role for someone who thrives on autonomy, proactivity, and making tangible improvements.

-Work with experienced, high-performing engineers in a complex product environment that offers both technical and organisational challenges.

-Play a key role in driving adoption of modern practices including AI-enabled ways of working and scalable engineering processes.

-Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and employee benefits space.

Great benefits:

🧠 ITP1 pension.

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.

📝 Collective agreement.

💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.

✈️ 30 vacation days / year.

💰 Referral bonuses.

🌟 Enhanced parental pay.

🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.

Role Overview 🚀

As Engineering Manager, you will lead two teams, one consisting of 6 people and the other of 4, responsible for complex domains within the Benifex platform. Their responsibilities span our mobile app, shared frontend framework, platform look and feel, and employee experience products, as well as Pay Transparency, Total Reward Statements and Projections, and the APIs and services that support employee documents and payslips. The teams combine product development with the ongoing improvement of a large, established codebase, with a focus on reliability, accessibility and continuous improvement. You will drive delivery, coach your teams to improve performance, and ensure smooth collaboration across this distributed setup. This is a leadership role with a strong focus on people, delivery, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means proactively identifying opportunities, removing bottlenecks, and enabling your teams to consistently perform at their best.

Responsibilities 🤘

-Lead and develop two engineering teams, ensuring strong delivery performance, clear accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

-Act as first escalation point for engineers, guiding work, estimations, removing blockers, and supporting day-to-day delivery.

-Own delivery outcomes across teams, tracking progress, velocity, and ensuring commitments against roadmap and goals are met.

-Partner closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads to align on roadmap, priorities, and execution.

-Coach engineers and tech leads, providing feedback, supporting growth, and strengthening overall team capability.

-Drive agile ways of working, ensuring effective ceremonies, strong execution, and continuous improvement while balancing team autonomy.

-Standardise and evolve engineering practices and processes (e.g. code quality, ways of working) together with other Engineering Managers.

-Use OKRs, metrics, and delivery tracking to measure quality, performance, and progress.

-Champion adoption of AI and modern tooling to improve engineering efficiency and effectiveness.

What are we looking for? 🔎

-Proven experience as an Engineering Manager with strong leadership seniority and a track record of building and leading high-performing engineering teams with a focus on delivery, continuous improvement, and measurable results.

-Strong technical understanding from a software engineering background, with ability to translate product requirements into team plans, capacity, and execution.

-Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, feedback, and the ability to build trust and motivation in teams.

-Solid understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban), including sprint planning, estimation, task breakdown, and iterative delivery.

-Ability to drive engineering quality, including high coding standards, maintainability, testing practices, and prevention of technical debt.

-Collaborative and empathetic leadership style with strong communication skills and ability to work closely with engineers, tech leads, product managers, and other stakeholders.

-Strong interest in modern engineering practices, including Generative AI (Prompt Engineering, Fine Tuning, RAG) and adoption of AI/tools to improve efficiency.

-Passion for product and quality, with a focus on both user value and engineering standards and excellence.

We look forward to receiving your application!

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage during the recruitment process, please let us know with your application.

title: Senior Data Engineer to Home Furnishing Company
description:
We are looking for a senior Data Engineer on behalf of our client, a global leader in the home furnishing retail industry. They are establishing digital products that provide performance insights for customer meeting points and franchisees. The products consolidate data from multiple business systems into trusted, scalable and automated data products that support performance management, business decision-making, continuous improvement and strategic planning.

About the assignment

As data engineer in the team, you design, build and maintain automated, scalable data solutions for two performance evaluation products, one for customer meeting points and one for franchisees, stretching across all of the client's franchisees. The goal is to transform today's manual, fragmented reporting into a reliable and centralized analytics ecosystem, giving leadership and management teams consistent, trustworthy metrics for trend analysis and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

    

Design, build and maintain automated, scalable data solutions for the performance evaluation products

    

Create the data foundation that enables reporting, analytics, governance and future scalability

    

Connect data from multiple sources into a unified performance evaluation framework covering multiple criteria

    

Ensure accuracy, data validation, version control and auditability

We are looking for you who

Are a senior data engineer with:

    

Proven experience designing and implementing end-to-end data pipelines, batch and streaming, including ingestion, transformation and serving layers, using best practices in data modelling and lakehouse architecture

    

Hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Apache Spark, Delta Lake, job orchestration, performance tuning and environment management

    

Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, particularly services commonly used in data platforms such as Azure Data Lake Storage

    

Solid experience with DevOps practices, including source control (e.g. Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment promotion and infrastructure as code for data platfor

How you work

    

Comfortable working in the early phases of solution design and contributing throughout the full data engineering lifecycle: ideation, high and low level architecture, requirements specification, functional and technical design, estimation, sprint planning, development, testing, documentation, deployment and operational follow-up

    

Strong understanding of data engineering guidelines, release processes and quality expectations, including data validation, performance optimization, monitoring and troubleshooting in production environments

    

Focused on building clean, scalable, resilient and cost-efficient data solutions using cloud native architectures and modern data platforms, with maintainability and reusability in mind

    

Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain data architectures, pipelines and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Practical details

    

Start: 2026-11-01

Workload: 100 %

    

Location: Malmö, on site (no remote work)

Send your updated CV in Word format together with a short motivation. Describe why you are the right fit for this assignment, referring to previous consulting assignments, employments, education and personal qualities that are relevant.

For this assignment you will be hired as a full-time consultant by Digitalenta. We offer our consultants a generous package including healthcare allowance, insurance policy, paid vacation days and pension savings. In addition, you'll also have a dedicated consultant manager available throughout your employment with us, in addition to optional networking activities with our network of consultants.

title: AI Ops Engineer (People Team)
description:
TL;DR

We're looking for an exceptional AI Software Engineer to build the AI-powered People systems that help Lovable scale.

As Lovable grows, we're rethinking how work gets done. Rather than relying on traditional HR software, we're building AI-native products that transform hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, identity, compliance, and other core People workflows.

You'll work embedded with our People team, partnering closely with stakeholders to understand problems, design solutions, and ship production-ready software. Many of the products you build won't stop at improving Lovable internally — they have the potential to become capabilities we offer to customers in the future, giving you the opportunity to shape products that start inside Lovable and scale far beyond it.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

Why join now?

Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership.

You'll help define how AI transforms internal operations. You'll work directly with the People team to identify problems, design solutions, and build products that improve how Lovable operates every day.

As Lovable scales, we're building the operating system the company runs on—function by function, directly in Lovable. The People team is one of the first. You'll help define how AI transforms one of our most important internal functions, and the best ideas will eventually become building blocks for our customers.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a software engineer with strong product instincts and experience building secure software that handles sensitive information.

You'll likely have:

    Experience shipping production software that handles sensitive data — HR tech, fintech, identity management, or similar.
    Experience working with people data, business systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data infrastructure (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow, Fivetran, SQL, etc.).
    Deep familiarity with HR systems and/or ATS platforms (HiBob, Ashby, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar), either as a builder or through close collaboration with People teams.
    Experience designing secure systems with role-based access control and data permissioning.
    Strong product instincts—you think end-to-end, ask why, and care about building products people actually use.
    Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate operational challenges into technical solutions.
    Experience building products from scratch and taking them into production.

Bonus points if you have:

    Experience at an HR technology company, Work OS platform, or identity provider,
    Experience with HRIS, ATS, compensation, workforce planning tools.
    Experience building AI-powered products or internal tooling.
    Experience working closely with People or Operations teams.

What you'll do

In one sentence:

Build AI-powered People systems that make Lovable run better — and create products that can graduate from internal tools to customer-facing features.

Examples include:

    Partner with the People team to identify, scope, and ship AI-powered internal products.
    Build integrations with HR systems (HiBob, Ashby, etc.), ATS platforms, and identity providers.
    Design secure systems with robust role-based permissions and access controls.
    Develop predictive and diagnostic models (workforce trends, hiring capacity, retention risks, compensation dynamics).
    Create canonical datasets and source-of-truth models for hiring, headcount, compensation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
    Data governance — source-of-truth logic, naming conventions, ownership.
    Own products end-to-end—from research and design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
    Translate operational challenges into elegant technical solutions.
    Build systems that meet legal and compliance requirements for handling sensitive employee data.
    Work closely with other AI Ops Engineers, sharing building blocks, patterns, and learnings across Lovable's functions.
    Build AI agents, workflows, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leaders make better decisions.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love.

Languages: TypeScript, Python, Go

AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP, AI Agents

Business Systems: HiBob, Ashby, Okta

Infrastructure: Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Temporal

We're always looking for better tools and better ways of building software.

About your application

Please submit your application in English — it's our company language.

We review every application carefully and encourage anyone excited by the role to apply, even if your background doesn't perfectly match every bullet point.

title: English speaking personal assistant in Järfälla

description:

The information you give us about your work permit and residence will be followed up with Immigration for safety reasons.

For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.

You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.

Support for your family

Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.

Language training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.

Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.

Requirements

We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.

Interested?

Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Strategic Global Procurement Lead
description:
At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.



Position Overview

As the Strategic Global Procurement Lead, you will design, implement, and mature our global category management and strategic sourcing framework. You will be reporting directly to the Global Head of Supply Chain & Procurement and oversee a multi-million-euro spend across both direct and indirect spend categories. Your primary mission is two-fold: on the one hand you’ll be initiating and driving short term cost reduction initiatives, both on direct and indirect, and in parallel you’ll be tasked to design, build and implement the future global procurement organization to support our strategic direction. This combination requires a hands-on person that’s able to simplify complex topics, understands what data is needed to drive improvements (and knows how to collect this data when not available) and has experience pitching strategic initiatives to senior leadership. It’s a crucial role in the organization and a unique opportunity to truly make a difference and help to set up our organization for future success.

Key Responsibilities

    

Cost reduction initiatives: initiate, drive and implement cost reduction across direct and indirect spend, teaming up and working with relevant stakeholders within and outside our organization

    

Organization: lead and develop our global procurement team in place today and in parallel design, implement and mature a global procurement organization set to support our strategic direction including the required supporting processes and systems

    

Supplier Database & Lifecycle Management: build, structure, and maintain a centralized global supplier database containing up-to-date contracts, tiered pricing architectures, product/service portfolios, and comprehensive supplier profiles

    

Supplier Risk Assessment & Mitigation: own the end-to-end supplier risk management framework; develop data-driven risk assessment profiles (financial health, operational capacity, geopolitical risks, and compliance) for all key vendors

    

Category Strategy: own and execute long-term global category strategies to optimize cost, quality, and supply continuity

    

Low-Cost Country Sourcing (LCCS): identify, evaluate, and onboard high-potential suppliers to optimize Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

    

Supplier Relationship Management (SRM): govern relationships with critical global suppliers, leading executive business reviews, KPI monitoring, and performance audits

    

Contract Negotiation: lead high-value contract lifecycle management, securing robust commercial terms, IP protection, and medical regulatory compliance

    

Cross-Functional Collaboration: partner with R&D, Quality, and Regulatory teams to seamlessly onboard and qualify new suppliers during New Product Introduction (NPI) phases

What We Are Looking For

    

Education: University degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent.

    

Experience: minimum of 15 years track record in strategic procurement, category management, or global sourcing within a highly regulated sector, including leadership of a global procurement team

    

Data & Database Management: proven experience in building or maturing master data frameworks, supplier information systems, or advanced SRM databases from the ground up

    

Project Management: experience in leading global, cross-functional projects with a proven track-record to deliver on results. Lean Six Sigma experience is considered to be a strong advantage

    

Risk Management Expertise: strong background in creating structured Supplier Risk Assessment profiles, methodologies, and tracking tools (e.g., FMEA, financial health indices)

    

Global Sourcing Expertise: track record of successfully mapping, auditing, and developing new supplier networks in low-cost manufacturing regions (e.g., APAC, Eastern Europe, LATAM)

    

Industry Knowledge & Regulatory Acumen: direct experience in MedTech, Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, or Biotechnology (under frameworks like ISO 13485 or GMP) is highly valued

    

Systems: Highly proficient with global ERP networks (Jeeves/Navision considered a plus), Excel, and modern procurement analytics / BI dashboard methodologies

    

Languages: Full professional proficiency in English. Additional European languages (Spanish, Swedish, or Danish) is considered to be a strong advantage



Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible, the position might be filled before the last application date.

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.

We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Senior SCADA / OT Systems Engineer to a global company in Ludvika
description:
Our client is a global technology company within power transmission and electrification. The organization designs, builds, and upgrades high-voltage transmission installations that move electricity across regions and countries, and its technology is a key enabler of the ongoing energy transition. The site in Ludvika is one of the company's main engineering centres in Sweden, with a large international engineering community and a strong technical tradition.

About HVDC Service

The HVDC Service organisation works with upgrades, service and warranty support for HVDC installations already in operation around the world. Since these installations have a lifespan of around many years and are upgraded regularly, this is a long, ongoing pipeline of brownfield engineering work.  

About the role

We are looking for a Senior SCADA / OT Systems Engineer to join our client's engineering organization supporting power system and automation projects. In this role, you will contribute to the design, implementation and modernization of SCADA, control and monitoring systems, while supporting cybersecurity initiatives within our deliveries.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with power utilities, substation automation, industrial communication systems and IT/OT integration. We are looking for a senior profile with a strong understanding of operational technology environments, network architecture and cybersecurity principles for critical infrastructure.

Previous experience from large-scale utility, power transmission, substation automation or grid modernization projects is highly valued.

Responsibilities

• Support engineering teams in the design, implementation and commissioning of SCADA and control system solutions. • Contribute to OT cybersecurity activities and ensure alignment with applicable standards and best practices. • Participate in modernization and upgrade projects involving station control and monitoring systems. • Support discussions with customers and stakeholders regarding SCADA, IT/OT infrastructure and operational requirements. • Coordinate testing, FAT/SAT activities and site commissioning when required. • Provide technical guidance and support to project teams throughout the project lifecycle.

Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within relevant field  • Several years of experience working with SCADA, substation automation, power systems or industrial control systems. • Good understanding of industrial communication protocols such as IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA or similar. • Experience with network architecture, high-availability systems and IT/OT integration. • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts related to industrial environments and critical infrastructure. • Fluent English is required. Swedish is considered an advantage • Experience working in international and multicultural project environments.

Meritorious

• Experience from electrical utilities, transmission systems, HVDC, renewable integration or energy infrastructure projects. • Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity frameworks, standards and secure network design. • Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers or coordinating multidisciplinary project activities. • Project Management certification or experience managing technical project deliveries. • Experience with SCADA migrations, control system upgrades and operational technology modernization initiatives.

Other:

Location: Presence in Ludvika is mandatory.

Start date: According to agreement

Employment type: You will initially be employed by A-hub as a consultant, with the ambition of moving to direct employment with our client after 12 months

Security screening: Background and security checks will be conducted as part of the recruitment process. Some roles require Swedish citizenship.

A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy (https://www.a-hub.se/integritetspolicy).

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Do you thrive in collaborative teams and want your work to shape what players experience every day?

As a Backend Developer at Snowprint, you’ll build the backend systems, infrastructure, and tools that power our games. You’ll work closely with your fellow developers, designers, and other disciplines to create stable, scalable solutions, always with the player experience in mind.

At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and self-leadership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take ownership, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together.

What you’ll be doing

You'll bring new game features to life while also supporting the systems, tooling, and infrastructure behind them. The role combines feature development with live operations, giving you the opportunity to work on both player-facing functionality and the technical foundations that keep the game running.

You'll take ownership of the technical areas you work on, from planning and implementation to testing and live operations. A normal week might include feature development, playtests, troubleshooting production issues, discussing technical approaches with the team, and improving systems to support future needs as the game evolves.

You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues to shape technical solutions that work well for both the game and the people building it.

Is this you?

    

You’re an experienced backend developer who is fluent in Kotlin and/or Java and has experience working with live backend services. You’re comfortable operating cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS.

    

You’re comfortable with live operations, including troubleshooting complex production issues and balancing bug fixing and fine-tuning with longer-term improvements and planning.

    

You take ownership of your work and are comfortable working independently while staying connected to the bigger picture. You enjoy solving problems, making decisions, and seeing things through from idea to implementation.

    

You communicate clearly and collaborate well with colleagues across different disciplines. You’re comfortable asking questions, discussing technical approaches, and working through problems together.

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace. Join us in shaping the future of gaming!

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner ‘Mobile game of the year’ and ‘Best strategy game’ 2022

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner 'Best game we are still playing’ 2024 & 2026

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Finalist, ‘Best developer’ 2025

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner, ‘Best updated game’ & ‘Best community’ 2026

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

Vous êtes titulaire d’une certification **COFREND Niveau II** dans une ou plusieurs méthodes CND.

Vous maîtrisez une ou plusieurs des techniques suivantes : **ressuage, courants de Foucault, ultrasons**.

Rümlang liegt nordwestlich von Zürich und besticht durch seine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn A1 und zum öffentlichen Nahverkehr. Die Nähe zum Flughafen Zürich macht die Region für international tätige Unternehmen besonders attraktiv. - Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Bezugspflege

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Rümlang verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachfrauen und -männer mit Fokus auf Bezugspflege ist in der Region Rümlang weiterhin geprägt von hoher Nachfrage und ausgezeichneten Chancen. Spitäler, Kliniken und Pflegeinstitutionen suchen kontinuierlich nach qualifizierten Fachkräften für Positionen im 80-100%-Pensum, da der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen anhält. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als etablierter Vermittler bei der Stellensuche durch fundierte Marktkenntnis, persönliche Betreuung und direkte Kontakte zu namhaften Arbeitgebern, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg in die Region ermöglicht.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Rümlang

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Rümlang

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Rümlang wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

Pour une grande organisation basée en Suisse romande, nous recherchons un développeur Oracle eBusiness Suite (OeBS) senior. Vous renforcerez l'équipe sur les projets en cours et sur la maintenance évolutive des applications OeBS.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'une dizaine de professionnels : chefs de projet, gestionnaires de service et développeurs. Votre mission principale sera de concevoir et développer des solutions à partir de spécifications fonctionnelles, en tirant le meilleur parti des fonctionnalités standard du progiciel. Votre expertise permettra de livrer des solutions bien intégrées au standard et conformes aux exigences de qualité.

* Réaliser l'analyse technique à partir des spécifications fonctionnelles, identifier les solutions possibles et les risques techniques, puis recommander et justifier la solution retenue

* Rendre compte régulièrement au chef de projet ou au gestionnaire de service de l'avancement, du reste à faire et des risques techniques

* Assurer le support des applications financières, de la prise en charge des incidents jusqu'au déploiement des correctifs, en communiquant de manière adaptée avec les différents interlocuteurs

* Appliquer les standards de conception, de développement, de tests et de sécurité en vigueur, et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques

* Maintenir à jour la documentation technique

**Formation et compétences clés**

* Diplôme HES, licence en informatique, diplôme d'ingénieur EPF ou diplôme fédéral

* Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement sur Oracle eBusiness Suite, idéalement en version R12

* Expertise en SQL et PL/SQL, et bonne connaissance du modèle de données OeBS des modules Finances

* Bonne connaissance technique et fonctionnelle des modules OeBS GL, AP, AR, PO, PA et FA

* Bonne maîtrise des outils de gestion de versions (Git, SVN, etc.) et des processus d'ingénierie logicielle

**Atouts**

* Développement Oracle APEX, idéalement dans un contexte OeBS

* Oracle Workflow Builder, notamment les workflows du processus d'approvisionnement

* Oracle Application Framework (OAF) : pages spécifiques, extension de composants standards et mécanismes de personnalisation

* BI Publisher, ainsi qu'Oracle Forms et Reports

* Expérience de projets OeBS dans le secteur public

* Expérience du travail en environnement Agile

**Qualités personnelles**

* Sens des responsabilités et aisance dans le contact avec les clients et les utilisateurs

* Esprit d'initiative et autonomie

* Esprit d'équipe et capacité à gérer la pression

* Bonnes compétences de communication orale et écrite

* Ouverture au changement

Architekt Security Generative AI / Cloud
========================================







**Architekt Security Generative AI / Cloud**



**Projekt:** Für unseren Kunden aus der Finanzbranche suchen wir einen erfahrenen Security Architekt (w/m/d), der Sicherheitsarchitekturen im Umfeld von Generative AI und Cloud verantwortet und zukunftsfähige Guardrails, Zugriffs\- und Überwachungskonzepte für komplexe Applikationslandschaften entwickelt. (Referenznummer: 925292MC)  

**Aufgaben:** • Konzeption, Design und Weiterentwicklung von Security\-Architekturen für generative AI\-Plattformen (z.B. LLM, RAG, AI Agents) in Cloud\-Umgebungen  
• Erarbeitung von Guardrails, Access\- \& Authorization\-Konzepten sowie Monitoring\- und Logging\-Ansätzen für komplexe, verteilte Anwendungen  
• Bewertung und Absicherung von Use Cases im Bereich Generative AI hinsichtlich Risiken wie Prompt Injection, Jailbreaking, Data Leakage und unautorisierte Wissensaggregation  
• Beratung von Projektteams, Product Ownern und Management in Sicherheitsfragen rund um AI, Cloud und Applikationssicherheit  
• Definition von Security\-Standards, Richtlinien und Best Practices sowie Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Architektur\- und Sicherheitsdokumentationen  
• Unterstützung bei Risikoanalysen, Threat Modelling und Security\-Reviews von AI\- und Cloud\-Lösungen  
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Cloud\-Engineering, Development, Risk Management und Compliance  

**Anforderungen:** • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Security Architekt in komplexen Unternehmensumgebungen  
• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Guardrails, Zugriffs\- und Berechtigungskonzepten sowie Monitoring\-/Logging\-Strategien für komplexe Applikationen

* Du analysierst und behebst Störungen, führst Root\-Cause\-Analysen durch und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Observability ein. Als Teil des Teams bist du Anlaufstelle für interne Teams, Kunden und Partner und übernimmst im Turnus die 2nd\-Level\-Support\-Bereitschaft und Rufbereitschaft
* Du entwickelst unser Monitoring mit Prometheus und Grafana aktiv weiter, erstellst aussagekräftige Dashboards und Alerts und sorgst dafür, dass potenzielle Probleme frühzeitig erkannt werden
* Du automatisierst den Aufbau und die Verwaltung unserer Cloud\-Infrastruktur mit Terraform und sorgst mit ArgoCD, Docker und CI/CD dafür, dass neue Anwendungen zuverlässig und automatisiert auf Kubernetes bereitgestellt werden

* Du hältst unsere Runbooks und Betriebsdokumentation aktuell, optimierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und automatisierst, was nicht manuell erledigt werden muss


**Wir suchen Macher**

* Abgeschlossene Lehre, 1\-3 Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Gebiet
* Breite Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Security, Virtualisierung, Container (Docker/Kubernetes)
* Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools (Ansible, Terraform) und Skriptsprachen (Bash, )
* Fundiertes Linux Knowhow (Ubuntu/Debian, RedHat/CentOS)
* Neugier, effizientes Arbeiten und unternehmerisches Denken
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse


**Starke Gründe für BSI**

* Flexible Karrierewege und vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
* Persönliche Betreuung, im Projektalltag und für deine Weiterentwicklung
* Wertschätzende Firmenkultur, keine Hierarchie

* Beitrag zum Mittagessen (Lunch Check)
* Flexible Arbeitsorte
* Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf, Sabbatical und Workation innerhalb der EU

Développeur Oracle eBusiness Suite (OeBS) Senior (H/F/X)

Groupe de conseil international fondé en 2019, Ekkiden anime un écosystème de consultants passionnés et engagés qui mènent des projets de transformation organisationnelle, opérationnelle et technologique dans l'IT/Digital, l'Industrie/R\&D et la sustainability, chez les grands comptes et PME, en , Suisse, Espagne et Allemagne.



Développeur Oracle eBusiness Suite (OeBS) Senior (H/F/X)
=========================================================



Le rôle :
----------



Pour une grande organisation basée en Suisse romande, nous recherchons un développeur Oracle eBusiness Suite (OeBS) senior. Vous renforcerez l'équipe sur les projets en cours et sur la maintenance évolutive des applications OeBS.



Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'une dizaine de professionnels : chefs de projet, gestionnaires de service et développeurs. Votre mission principale sera de concevoir et développer des solutions à partir de spécifications fonctionnelles, en tirant le meilleur parti des fonctionnalités standard du progiciel. Votre expertise permettra de livrer des solutions bien intégrées au standard et conformes aux exigences de qualité.









Responsabilités :
------------------



*      Réaliser l'analyse technique à partir des spécifications fonctionnelles, identifier les solutions possibles et les risques techniques, puis recommander et justifier la solution retenue

  

*      Développer dans le respect des délais et des exigences de qualité, et préparer puis exécuter les tests unitaires et de charge

  

*      Rendre compte régulièrement au chef de projet ou au gestionnaire de service de l'avancement, du reste à faire et des risques techniques

  

*      Assurer le support des applications financières, de la prise en charge des incidents jusqu'au déploiement des correctifs, en communiquant de manière adaptée avec les différents interlocuteurs

  

*      Appliquer les standards de conception, de développement, de tests et de sécurité en vigueur, et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques

  

*      Maintenir à jour la documentation technique

  







Ce que nous recherchons :
-------------------------



**Formation et compétences clés**



*      Diplôme HES, licence en informatique, diplôme d'ingénieur EPF ou diplôme fédéral

  

*      Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement sur Oracle eBusiness Suite, idéalement en version R12

  

*      Expertise en SQL et PL/SQL, et bonne connaissance du modèle de données OeBS des modules Finances

  

*      Bonne connaissance technique et fonctionnelle des modules OeBS GL, AP, AR, PO, PA et FA

  

*      Bonne maîtrise des outils de gestion de versions (Git, SVN, etc.) et des processus d'ingénierie logicielle

  



**Atouts**



*      Développement Oracle APEX, idéalement dans un contexte OeBS

  

*      Oracle Workflow Builder, notamment les workflows du processus d'approvisionnement

  

*      Oracle Application Framework (OAF) : pages spécifiques, extension de composants standards et mécanismes de personnalisation

  

*      BI Publisher, ainsi qu'Oracle Forms et Reports

  

*      Expérience de projets OeBS dans le secteur public

  

*      Expérience du travail en environnement Agile

  



**Qualités personnelles**



*      Sens des responsabilités et aisance dans le contact avec les clients et les utilisateurs

  

*      Esprit d'initiative et autonomie

  

*      Esprit d'équipe et capacité à gérer la pression

  

*      Bonnes compétences de communication orale et écrite

  

*      Ouverture au changement

title: Director, Medical Governance Partner
description:
About the role

Serves as the Medical Governance Office's primary global-to-local governance partner, providing practical governance support, advice and expert input to Business Units, regional and country Medical teams.

Provides MGO accountability for the governance framework supporting GxP and other regulated Medical activities globally, while preserving the distinct accountabilities of activity owners, independent Quality functions, Ethics & Compliance and independent Audit.

Helps Medical teams apply MGO frameworks, standards, minimum controls and tools consistently; maintains the integrated Global Medical risk view and supports proactive risk management, audit/inspection readiness, CAPA/remediation follow-up and escalation.

Acts as a single point of connection between countries, MGO capability owners and key partner functions, using country experience, risk signals and assurance outcomes to improve processes, tools and capabilities and accelerate country support and decision-making.



How you will contribute

Lead the MGO governance framework for GxP and other regulated Medical activities globally, ensuring clear standards, minimum controls, activity classification, decision rights, documentation expectations, escalation routes and interfaces with independent Quality oversight.

Serve as the principal MGO governance partner to Business Unit, regional, cluster and country Medical leaders and activity owners; provide practical guidance and coaching and help teams navigate complex requirements, ownership questions and cross-functional dependencies.

Connect countries with the appropriate MGO capability owners - including Evidence Generation, Patient Solutions, Data Dissemination, Grants & Sponsorships and other Medical governance domains - and coordinate coherent support without duplicating domain ownership.

Establish and maintain the integrated Global Medical risk register and risk view; proactively identify material and emerging risks, recurring themes and cross-country issues, support mitigation with accountable owners and escalate significant or unresolved concerns through appropriate governance channels.

Lead MGO coordination of proactive GIA audit readiness and Medical audit workstreams, including risk-based country preparation, documentation and evidence readiness, SME coordination, issue escalation and enterprise follow-up of findings, while preserving auditor independence.

Coordinate Medical readiness support for Quality audits and health-authority inspections with R&D Quality, Commercial Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs and local activity owners; ensure governance expectations, records and controls are clear and retrievable.

Support root-cause analysis, CAPA and remediation planning for Medical governance findings; monitor significant actions, overdue items and effectiveness at enterprise level while formal ownership and closure remain with the accountable business or Quality owner.

Monitor governance performance and adherence through appropriate risk indicators, KPIs, dashboards and issue tracking; provide timely feedback to strengthen processes, systems, tools and country support.

Act as a key cross-functional interface with Global Internal Audit, R&D Quality, Commercial Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Privacy, Procurement, Digital/DD&T and other relevant functions, facilitating resolution of ownership gaps and handoffs.

Build a global Medical governance network and continuous-learning loop between countries: capture country feedback, audit/CAPA themes and recurring questions; share effective practices; and translate insights into clearer guidance, 'how-to' materials, training inputs, tools and recommendations for MGO framework improvement.



Dimensions and Aspects

Global remit across Business Units, regions, clusters and countries in a regulated, matrixed environment with differing local requirements, Medical Affairs maturity and Quality footprints.

Works across Medical activities with non-GxP, GCP/GVP and GMP/GDP interfaces. Activity owners retain strategy and execution; MGO sets enterprise Medical governance expectations and risk visibility; Quality retains independent Quality authority; Audit retains independent assurance responsibilities.

Creates value for countries by providing an accessible route into MGO, reducing navigation complexity, connecting teams to the right expertise early and helping resolve governance issues before they become recurring findings or execution barriers.



Technical / Functional Expertise

Strong knowledge of Medical Affairs governance, quality systems and governance of GxP and other regulated Medical activities, including risk-based oversight, audit/inspection readiness, root-cause analysis, CAPA and remediation.

Ability to translate enterprise policies, standards and quality requirements into clear, practical guidance while maintaining appropriate boundaries between business ownership, MGO governance, Ethics & Compliance, independent Quality and Audit.



Leadership

Acts as a trusted advisor, coach and constructive challenger to Medical leaders and teams; promotes early engagement, transparency, learning and sustainable improvement rather than reactive compliance.

Influences without direct authority across geographies and seniority levels and brings the right stakeholders together to resolve ambiguity, recurring issues and cross-functional dependencies.



Decision-Making and Autonomy

Within approved MGO direction, determines the operating approach for global-to-local governance partnership, enterprise Medical risk visibility, proactive country support, audit-readiness coordination and cross-country issue follow-up.

Determines when MGO guidance is sufficient and when formal input or decision is required from Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs or another accountable function; recommends escalation or enterprise action based on risk and recurrence.



Interaction

Works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and MGO capability leads and maintains regular engagement with Business Unit/regional Medical leaders, Cluster Medical Heads, Country Medical Directors and Medical activity owners.

Coordinates closely with GIA/Enterprise Auditing, R&D Quality, Commercial Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, PV, RA, Privacy, Procurement, Digital/DD&T and other partner functions.



Innovation

Identifies opportunities to simplify governance and use data, analytics, automation and approved AI-enabled capabilities to improve risk sensing, governance visibility, audit readiness, knowledge reuse and decision support.



Complexity

Balances global consistency with valid local requirements across multiple Medical governance domains and functions, operating through partnership and matrix leadership rather than direct control of country teams.



Skills and qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, public health, healthcare management, quality, compliance or related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

10+ years of relevant experience in Medical Affairs, Medical governance, quality/compliance, Medical operations or related functions in the biopharmaceutical or healthcare industry.

Demonstrated experience with GxP and other regulated Medical activities and with Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs and Audit stakeholders.

Experience supporting global/regional/country Medical teams through governance guidance, risk assessment, audit or inspection readiness, CAPA/remediation, issue management or continuous improvement.

Proven success in complex global matrix organizations, including senior stakeholder influence.



Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of Medical governance, regulated-activity governance, risk-based oversight, audit/inspection readiness, CAPA and sustainable remediation.

Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; able to connect individual country issues to enterprise patterns and maintain meaningful risk views, metrics and dashboards.

Ability to create concise, practical governance guidance, decision aids, checklists, playbooks and learning materials and to manage cross-functional actions, escalation and follow-through.



Behavioural Competencies

Trusted-partner and customer-focused mindset with strong listening, coaching, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.

Excellent executive communication and judgment; able to frame complex governance issues, risks, implications and recommendations clearly and challenge constructively.

Collaborative, pragmatic and culturally sensitive working style with strong ownership, follow-through and commitment to transparency, learning and continuous improvement.



Languages

Fluent English required; additional languages advantageous.

Technicien Contrôle Non Destructif \- Réception H/F
=====================================================







Axepta recherche, pour l’un de ses clients basé dans la région de Montreux et actif dans le **secteur aérospatial**, un **Technicien Contrôle Non Destructif – CND Niveau II (H/F)**.



Vous intervenez sur le contrôle de pièces, d’ensembles mécanosoudés et de panneaux composites destinés à des applications aérospatiales, dans un environnement exigeant en matière de qualité, traçabilité et conformité.



Technicien Contrôle Non Destructif \- Réception H/F
=====================================================



Vos principales missions seront :



* Réaliser les contrôles non destructifs conformément aux procédures et exigences applicables.  
* Effectuer des contrôles par **ressuage fluorescent et/ou coloré** afin de détecter les défauts de surface.  
* Réaliser des contrôles par **courants de Foucault** à l’aide de sondes afin d’identifier fissures et discontinuités.  
* Effectuer des contrôles par **ultrasons** selon vos habilitations et les procédures en vigueur.  
* Interpréter les résultats des contrôles et statuer sur la conformité des pièces.  
* Identifier, documenter et remonter les éventuelles non\-conformités.  
* Rédiger les rapports de contrôle et assurer la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.  
* Garantir le respect des exigences qualité propres au **secteur aérospatial**.  


**Profil recherché**



Vous êtes titulaire d’une certification **COFREND Niveau II** dans une ou plusieurs méthodes CND.



Vous justifiez idéalement d’une expérience en environnement industriel, laboratoire ou production sur des **pièces mécanosoudées et/ou matériaux composites**, de préférence dans les secteurs **aéronautique, spatial ou défense**.



Vous maîtrisez une ou plusieurs des techniques suivantes : **ressuage, courants de Foucault, ultrasons**.



Une expérience sur **panneaux composites, structures sandwich ou pièces destinées à l’aérospatial** constitue un réel atout.

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Senior Procurement Specialist — interim (B2B) \- Braine, Belgium

Job description:

* **Start:** ASAP
* **Duration:** 4–6 months, with possible extension
* **Workload:** 100% / full\-time
* **Location:** Braine, Belgium
* **Working model:** 4 days on site, with 1 home\-office day possible
* **Travel:** Approx. monthly travel to Strasbourg, France (1–2 days)


As an **Interim Procurement Specialist**, you will support the procurement organization at the Braine site, working at the intersection of strategic procurement and operational purchasing. Your focus will be on sourcing activities for new site projects and direct materials rather than transactional purchasing or purchase\-order processing.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Develop sourcing strategies for new site projects together with Global Category Management and internal stakeholders.
* Manage RFQs and end\-to\-end supplier selection processes, including bid evaluation and commercial negotiations.
* Manage sourcing activities for direct materials within a GMP\-regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Negotiate and manage supply, development and equipment contracts within global procurement frameworks.
* Build and maintain relationships with national and international suppliers and monitor supplier performance.

DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
=======================

**Company Description**

MF Group is a subsidiary of Riverty and part of the Bertelsmann Group. Around 120 employees  
work across two locations in Switzerland to make invoice\-based purchasing with flexible  
installment payments even simpler and safer for Swiss retailers. As a leading Swiss provider, we  
are a key partner for the retail sector, combining credit checks, fraud prevention, invoicing, and  
pre\-financing into a comprehensive end‑to‑end solution.  
In addition to our straightforward invoice payment solutions—both online and in‑store—we offer  
private customers flexible cash loans. We also issue a variety of payment cards. Our strength  
lies in managing complex projects where multiple sales channels and payment methods interact  
seamlessly. We work with nearly all major brick‑and‑mortar and online retailers in Switzerland,  
actively shaping the future of payments.



**Description**

**We are looking for a  
DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)  
(unlimited, full\-time) Join our team at our location in Chiasso – flexible working conditions  
available**


As part of the Cloud \& Infrastructure team, you will play a key role in designing, automating, and  
operating CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure platforms supporting MF Group's critical business  
systems. You will contribute directly to modernizing our software delivery processes, improving  
deployment reliability, and enabling fast, secure, and repeatable delivery of applications across  
on\-premises and cloud environments.

The position is ideal for someone who enjoys automating repetitive work, bridging development and operations, and taking ownership of platform topics while driving the adoption of DevOps practices across teams.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI), collaborating closely with development teams to optimize build, test, and release workflows.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure as
* Code tools such as Ansible and Packer, contributing to cloud\-ready environments.
* Deploy, operate, and evolve containerized workloads on Kubernetes, drive the migration of services from virtual machines to containers, and support our cloud adoption.
* Improve observability and monitoring (e.g. New Relic or equivalent) and participate in incident handling and on\-call support to ensure stable and predictable platform operations.
* Own security hardening, patch management, and vulnerability remediation across infrastructure and the delivery pipeline.
* Define and maintain infrastructure standards, best practices, and technical documentation.




**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 4 years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with a proven track record of building and operating production systems.
* Solid experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar).
* Proven experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes and administering Linuxbased environments.
* Strong experience with Ansible; experience with Terraform, Packer, or similar tools.
* Experience operating delivery platforms in production (troubleshooting, incident handling, and on\-call support) combined with strong collaboration skills.




**Nice to have**

* Awareness of security, data protection, and compliance concepts (e.g. PII, GDPR).
* Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, payments, or banking.
* Experience with container security scanning and artifact management repositories (e.g. Sonatype Nexus).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g. New Relic, OpenTelemetry, Nagios/Centreon).
* Experience with Linux lifecycle management tools (e.g. Katello / Foreman) or Kubernetes management platforms.
* Experience with identity and SSO solutions (e.g. Keycloak, OIDC, Entra ID).

**VOUS CHERCHEZ UN MÉTIER UTILE, HUMAIN ET CONCRET ?**

Rejoignez les centres médico\-sociaux et contribuez activement au maintien à domicile des personnes qui en ont besoin.

**L'ASPMAD, C'EST :**

* 9 CMS dans le Nord vaudois
* 1000 collaborateur\-rice\-s engagé\-e\-s
* Plus de 6'700 personnes accompagnées chaque année
* Une présence dans 105 communes


**Auxiliaire polyvalent\-e 60% ou horaire**  

**POUR NOS CMS DE LA VALLÉE DE JOUX, NOUS RECRUTONS UN\-E : AUXILIAIRE POLYVALENT\-E 60% ou horaire**

**VOS MISSIONS**

En qualité d'auxiliaire polyvalent\-e, votre rôle implique d'avoir des compétences en lien avec :

* Soins de base et aide\-ménagère : capacité à fournir des soins et une assistance ménagère au domicile des clients.
* Suivi et relationnel client : aptitude à créer et maintenir des relations respectueuses avec les clients, tout en suivant les objectifs de prise en charge et en transmettant les informations pertinentes.
* Travail d'équipe : contribution au bon fonctionnement de l'équipe et collaboration avec ses membres.
* Gestion administrative : responsabilité des tâches administratives liées à la fonction.


**VOTRE PROFIL**

* Vous êtes titulaire d'une reconnaissance Croix\-Rouge d'auxiliaire de santé ou d'une qualification jugée équivalente.
* Une première expérience en institution constitue un réel atout.
* Doté(e) d'autonomie, de polyvalence et d'une grande capacité d'écoute, vous portez un intérêt marqué pour le maintien à domicile et la relation d'aide.
* Vous avez la capacité de vous adapter facilement à diverses situations, et l'écoute ainsi que la flexibilité font partie de vos atouts.
* Vous possédez un permis de conduire et, idéalement, un véhicule personnel.


**POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE**

* Un poste utile et valorisant
* Un quotidien riche en relations humaines
* Une équipe soudée et bienveillante
* Des outils mobiles (tablette) pour faciliter votre travail
* Des formations continues pour évoluer
* Un salaire et des avantages selon la CCT du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois
* Des avantages partenaires (sport, loisirs, essence)
* Possibilité de véhicule de service selon conditions

Bei unserer Auftraggeberin handelt es sich um eine unabhängige, sehr erfolgreich aufgestellte Vermögensverwaltungsunternehmung mit Sitz in unserer Region. Mit dieser Stellenausschreibung richten wir uns gezielt an den

Senior Relations Manager im Private Banking (m/w/d)

der auf eine erfolgreiche Beraterkarriere im Anlagegeschäft zurückblicken kann. Unsere Auftraggeberin bietet Ihnen eine ideale Plattform, in die Sie Ihre gefestigten Kundenbeziehungen einbringen können. Sie betreuen und beraten Ihre Kunden weiterhin, unabhängig von Produkt\- und Umsatzerwartungen, ganz nach dem Motto «Best\-in\-Class» und auf der Basis einer sehr erfolgreichen Anlagestrategie unserer Auftraggeberin, während die Bank\- und Depotbeziehungen Ihrer Kunden bestehen bleiben. **Beraterpersönlichkeit im Alter von 60 Jahren oder älter**

Sie verfügen über langjährig aufgebaute Kundenbeziehungen, die Sie weiterhin pflegen wollen und dabei Ihre Arbeitsbedingungen möglichst frei gestalten möchten (z. B. Arbeitszeit, Tätigkeitsdauer). In Sachen Asset\-Allocation, Compliance und Backoffice bietet Ihnen unsere Auftraggeberin einen hervorragenden Support, der Sie in allen operativen Detailaufgaben entlastet. Ihr Fokus liegt beim Kunden und seinen Bedürfnissen.

title: Auxiliaire de santé
description:
Ref 2583575 \| Ref entreprise: Auxiliaire de santé \| Date: 7 Oct 2026

![Fondation Soins Lausanne]( )

Nos centres Médico\-Sociaux (CMS) offrent à la population Lausannoise des **prestations pluridisciplinaires de qualité** et leurs interventions reposent sur des **valeurs d’humanité et d’équité**.



En rejoignant la **Fondation Soins Lausanne,** vous vous engagez de manière concrète en faveur de la santé et du bien\-vivre dans le canton de Vaud, au sein d’équipes expertes, motivées et enthousiastes, dans une activité variée et riche en contacts humains.



Sur le terrain, vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des bénéficiaires. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.



Afin de compléter nos équipes, les CMS de la **Fondation Soins Lausanne** recherche **de suite ou à convenir** plusieurs :





**Auxiliaire de santé (H/F)**

**Taux d'activité entre 50% et 80%**



**Contrat fixe à durée indeterminée**







Votre mission



* Assurer les prestations de **soins de base, d’hygiène et de confort** dans les activités quotidiennes et d’aide au maintien de l’ordre et de la propreté dans le milieu de vie
* Surveiller **l’état général** des clients et transmettre des **observations** utiles à la prise en charge de qualité dans la continuité des soins

Logisticien polyvalent
======================

**Votre mission**

Sous la responsabilité du Responsable Logistique, vous assurez principalement la préparation et l’organisation des expéditions en fonction des productions, des commandes et des priorités définies. Vous veillez au respect des délais, à la qualité des préparations et à la bonne traçabilité des opérations.

**Vos principales responsabilités**

* Préparer les commandes et les marchandises destinées à l’expédition.
* Contrôler la conformité des produits, des références et des quantités avant expédition.
* Organiser et conditionner les marchandises en fonction des exigences de transport et des spécificités des produits.
* Étiqueter et identifier correctement les colis, palettes et documents d’expédition.
* Préparer les documents nécessaires aux expéditions.
* Organiser les préparations en fonction des priorités, des productions et des commandes.
* Effectuer les contrôles nécessaires avant le départ des marchandises.
* Saisir et mettre à jour les informations dans le système informatique.
* Garantir la traçabilité des opérations et signaler toute anomalie ou différence constatée.
* Participer au chargement et au déchargement des marchandises dans le respect des règles de sécurité.
* Veiller à la propreté, à l’ordre et à la sécurité des zones de préparation, de stockage et d’expédition.
* Collaborer avec les équipes de production, de logistique, d’administration des ventes et de transport afin d’assurer le bon déroulement des opérations.
* En fonction des besoins du service, assurer ponctuellement le remplacement de collaborateurs sur différentes activités logistiques, notamment la réception des marchandises, le stockage, la préparation des approvisionnements et les inventaires.
* Respecter les procédures internes, (utilisation des machines, consignes de sécurité) les délais ainsi que les consignes de sécurité.


**Votre profil**

* Formation ou première expérience dans le domaine de la logistique, de la préparation de commandes ou dans un environnement similaire.
* Permis **cariste valable** en suisse avec **mat rétractable**, et chariot élévateur
* Bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques (Suite microsoft Office); une connaissance d’un ERP général ou de Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, constitue un réel atout.
* Bonne compréhension du français, à l’oral et à l’écrit
* Communiquant, capable d'expliquer les situations problématique et d'analyser les erreurs dans le système informatique.
* Si tu es intéressé par le poste ajoute le mot Chocolat en fin du petit mot qui te présente et qui explique pourquoi tu es intéressé par le poste
* Personnalité **rigoureuse**, **organisée** et **fiable**, avec un bon sens des responsabilités.
* Autonomie, esprit d’initiative et capacité à gérer les priorités.
* Goût pour le travail en équipe et aisance dans la collaboration avec différents services.
* Sensibilité à la qualité et à l’efficacité, avec une volonté de contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus
* Une affinité pour les sports de montagne, les sports d’hiver ou les sports d'extérieurs est un plus




**Ce que nous vous offrons**

* En répondant a cette annonce, nous vous garantissons une réponse individualisé à votre profil
* Un poste polyvalent et varié au sein d’une entreprise à taille humaine.
* Un environnement de travail dynamique, international et en constante évolution.
* La possibilité de travailler au sein d’un groupe reconnu dans l’univers des sports de montagne et de l’outdoor.
* Un cadre de travail favorisant l’autonomie, la collaboration et la prise d’initiative.




**Entrée en fonction** : à convenir  
**Lieu de travail** : Chavornay (VD)  
**Taux d’activité** : 100%  
**Type de contrat** : CDI

ée à Porrentruy, au cœur de l’Ajoie, notre filiale suisse réunit des activités de marketing, industrialisation et production dans le domaine des dispositifs médicaux orthopédiques.

Vous êtes Assistant(e) administratif(ve) expérimenté(e) et recherchez un poste varié, avec de l’autonomie et des responsabilités, au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine ?

Rejoignez , groupe français indépendant actif depuis plus de 20 ans, dont les produits sont aujourd’hui distribués dans 35 pays.

* Maîtrise du français écrit et bonnes capacités rédactionnelles
* Maîtrise de Microsoft Office : Word, Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook
* Maîtrise des outils Adobe pour la création et la mise en forme de supports
* Excellentes capacités d’organisation et de gestion des priorités
* Rigueur et souci du détail
* Aisance relationnelle et sens du service
* Autonomie, réactivité et capacité à prendre des initiatives
* Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs et activités simultanément




### Nous vous offrons

* L’opportunité de rejoindre un groupe international à taille humaine, reconnu dans le domaine des dispositifs médicaux

title: Senior Procurement Specialist — interim (B2B) - Braine, Belgium
description:
Interim Procurement Specialist for a GMP\-regulated pharmaceutical site, managing strategic sourcing, suppliers and contracts.

Senior Procurement Specialist — interim (B2B) \- Braine, Belgium

Job description:

* **Start:** ASAP
* **Duration:** 4–6 months, with possible extension
* **Workload:** 100% / full\-time
* **Location:** Braine, Belgium
* **Working model:** 4 days on site, with 1 home\-office day possible
* **Travel:** Approx. monthly travel to Strasbourg, France (1–2 days)


As an **Interim Procurement Specialist**, you will support the procurement organization at the Braine site, working at the intersection of strategic procurement and operational purchasing. Your focus will be on sourcing activities for new site projects and direct materials rather than transactional purchasing or purchase\-order processing.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Develop sourcing strategies for new site projects together with Global Category Management and internal stakeholders.
* Manage RFQs and end\-to\-end supplier selection processes, including bid evaluation and commercial negotiations.
* Manage sourcing activities for direct materials within a GMP\-regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Negotiate and manage supply, development and equipment contracts within global procurement frameworks.
* Build and maintain relationships with national and international suppliers and monitor supplier performance.
* Use market intelligence, commodity trends and price indices to challenge and negotiate supplier price increases.
* Identify savings opportunities, supplier consolidation potential and supply\-continuity risks.
* Coordinate with Global and Local Procurement and internal stakeholders on short\- and mid\-term demand requirements.
* Use SAP for relevant procurement activities while collaborating with the operational purchasing team responsible for transactional purchasing and master data.


About the customer:

Our client is an international pharmaceutical manufacturing organization operating in a highly regulated GMP environment. The company combines local site operations with global procurement structures and works with national and international suppliers across direct materials, equipment and project\-related sourcing.

Requirements:

* 3–7\+ years of professional experience in procurement, sourcing or strategic purchasing at specialist level.
* Proven responsibility for an annual spend of approximately **EUR 10–15 million**.
* Experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing or another **GMP\-regulated environment**, ideally involving direct materials.
* Strong hands\-on experience with project and/or strategic sourcing, including RFQs, bid evaluation, negotiations and supplier selection.
* Solid experience negotiating contracts within corporate or global procurement frameworks.
* Fluent **French and English**, both written and spoken.
* Based in Belgium or able to commute regularly to **Braine**.
* Availability to start immediately or at short notice.
* Willingness to travel to Strasbourg approximately once per month for 1–2 days.
Nice to have

* Experience collaborating with Global Category Management teams in a matrix organization.
* SAP MM / procurement user experience.
* Experience using commodity and price\-index analysis in supplier negotiations.
